# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generators/gen_culture_merges.py - do not edit manually.

# ---- german (north_german, south_german) ----

# Any scope. The german merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_german_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_german
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the german merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_german_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_german_core_ok = {
	OR = {
		te_cmg_german_north_german_measured = yes
		te_cmg_german_north_german_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_german_south_german_measured = yes
		te_cmg_german_south_german_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. north_german is free for the german merge.
te_cmg_german_north_german_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. north_german passes its gates for the german merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_german_north_german_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_german_north_german ?= 1
	te_cmg_german_north_german_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german }
}

# Country scope. north_german joined the german merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_german_north_german_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_german_north_german ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german
}

# Country scope. north_german (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the german merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_german_north_german_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_german_north_german ?= 1
	te_cmg_german_north_german_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_german_north_german ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german }
	NOT = { te_cmg_german_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Country scope. north_german waits on a vanilla journal entry that some country holds (je_german_unification_idea, R37) and the merge
# has not yet waited te_cm_wait_cap_years: it doesn't join, and a core part doesn't let the merge start.
te_cmg_german_north_german_waiting = {
	any_country = {
		has_journal_entry = je_german_unification_idea
	}
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_german
			trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_german } var:te_cm_wait_years_german >= te_cm_wait_cap_years }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the german merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_german_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_german_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_german
			global_var:te_cm_starter_german = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_german_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:north_german value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:south_german value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_alemannic }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:alemannic value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_east_german }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:east_german value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The german merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_german_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_german }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_german
			global_var:te_cm_starter_german = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the german merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_german (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_german_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_german
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_german
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_german
			te_cmg_german_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The german merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_german.
te_cmg_german_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_german
	global_var:te_cm_starter_german = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_german }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_german }
}

# Any scope. No part of the german merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_german_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_german_north_german ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_german_south_german ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_german_alemannic ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_alemannic }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_german_east_german ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_east_german }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The german merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_german_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_german_north_german ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_german_south_german ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_german_north_german ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_german_south_german ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Everything the german merge needs to start except its waits on vanilla entries
# (each condition its own custom_tooltip). The census adds a wait year while this holds and an entry is open.
te_cmg_german_start_basics = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_german_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_german_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_german_north_german_measured = yes
			te_cmg_german_north_german_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_german_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_german_south_german_measured = yes
			te_cmg_german_south_german_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_german ?= 1
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the german merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_german_can_start = {
	te_cmg_german_start_basics = yes
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_german_wait_north_german_tt
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				any_country = {
					has_journal_entry = je_german_unification_idea
				}
			}
			AND = {
				has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_german
				trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_german } var:te_cm_wait_years_german >= te_cm_wait_cap_years }
			}
		}
	}
}

	}
}

# Any scope. The italian merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_italian_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_italian }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_italian
			global_var:te_cm_starter_italian = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the italian merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_italian (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_italian_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_italian
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_italian
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_italian
			te_cmg_italian_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The italian merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_italian.
te_cmg_italian_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_italian
	global_var:te_cm_starter_italian = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_italian }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_italian }
}

# Any scope. No part of the italian merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_italian_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_italian_north_italian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_italian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_italian_south_italian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_italian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_italian_corsican ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_corsican }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The italian merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_italian_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_italian_north_italian ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_italian
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_italian_south_italian ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_italian
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_italian_north_italian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_italian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_italian_south_italian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_italian }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the italian merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_italian_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_result_not_merged_on
		NOT = { te_cmg_italian_result_switched = yes }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_italian_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_italian
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_italian
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_italian_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_italian_north_italian_measured = yes
			te_cmg_italian_north_italian_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_italian_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_italian_south_italian_measured = yes
			te_cmg_italian_south_italian_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_italian ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- scandinavian (swedish, danish, norwegian) ----

# Any scope. The scandinavian merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_scandinavian_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_scandinavian
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the scandinavian merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_scandinavian_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:swedish
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:danish
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:norwegian
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_scandinavian_core_ok = {
	OR = {
		te_cmg_scandinavian_swedish_measured = yes
		te_cmg_scandinavian_swedish_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_scandinavian_danish_measured = yes
		te_cmg_scandinavian_danish_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_scandinavian_norwegian_measured = yes
		te_cmg_scandinavian_norwegian_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. swedish is free for the scandinavian merge.
te_cmg_scandinavian_swedish_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. swedish passes its gates for the scandinavian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_scandinavian_swedish_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_scandinavian_swedish ?= 1
	te_cmg_scandinavian_swedish_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swedish }
}

# Country scope. swedish joined the scandinavian merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_scandinavian_swedish_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_swedish ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swedish
}

# Country scope. swedish (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the scandinavian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_scandinavian_swedish_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_scandinavian_swedish ?= 1
	te_cmg_scandinavian_swedish_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_swedish ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swedish }
	NOT = { te_cmg_scandinavian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. danish is free for the scandinavian merge.
te_cmg_scandinavian_danish_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. danish passes its gates for the scandinavian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_scandinavian_danish_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_scandinavian_danish ?= 1
	te_cmg_scandinavian_danish_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_danish }
}

# Country scope. danish joined the scandinavian merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_scandinavian_danish_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_danish ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_danish
}

# Country scope. danish (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the scandinavian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_scandinavian_danish_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_scandinavian_danish ?= 1
	te_cmg_scandinavian_danish_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_danish ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_danish }
	NOT = { te_cmg_scandinavian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. norwegian is free for the scandinavian merge.
te_cmg_scandinavian_norwegian_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. norwegian passes its gates for the scandinavian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).

	var:te_cm_ok_scandinavian_norwegian ?= 1
	te_cmg_scandinavian_norwegian_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_norwegian }

	global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_norwegian ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_norwegian
}

# Country scope. norwegian (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the scandinavian merge now: it has not switched

	var:te_cm_ok_scandinavian_norwegian ?= 1
	te_cmg_scandinavian_norwegian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_norwegian ?= 1 }

	NOT = { te_cmg_scandinavian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. icelandic is free for the scandinavian merge.
te_cmg_scandinavian_icelandic_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. icelandic passes its gates for the scandinavian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_scandinavian_icelandic_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_scandinavian_icelandic ?= 1
	te_cmg_scandinavian_icelandic_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_icelandic }
}

# Country scope. icelandic joined the scandinavian merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_scandinavian_icelandic_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_icelandic ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_icelandic
}

# Country scope. icelandic (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the scandinavian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_scandinavian_icelandic_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_scandinavian_icelandic ?= 1
	te_cmg_scandinavian_icelandic_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_icelandic ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_icelandic }
	NOT = { te_cmg_scandinavian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_scandinavian_icelandic ?= 1
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the scandinavian merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_scandinavian_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_scandinavian_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_scandinavian
			global_var:te_cm_starter_scandinavian = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_scandinavian_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swedish }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:swedish value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_danish }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:danish value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_norwegian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:norwegian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_icelandic }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:icelandic value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The scandinavian merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_scandinavian_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_scandinavian }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_scandinavian
			global_var:te_cm_starter_scandinavian = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the scandinavian merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_scandinavian (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_scandinavian_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_scandinavian
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_scandinavian
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_scandinavian
			te_cmg_scandinavian_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The scandinavian merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_scandinavian.
te_cmg_scandinavian_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_scandinavian
	global_var:te_cm_starter_scandinavian = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_scandinavian }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_scandinavian }
}

# Any scope. No part of the scandinavian merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_scandinavian_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_swedish ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swedish }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_danish ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_danish }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_norwegian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_norwegian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_icelandic ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_icelandic }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The scandinavian merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_scandinavian_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_swedish ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swedish
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_danish ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_danish
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_norwegian ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_norwegian
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_swedish ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swedish }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_danish ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_danish }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_norwegian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_norwegian }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the scandinavian merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_scandinavian_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_scandinavian_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:swedish
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:danish
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:norwegian
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_scandinavian_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_scandinavian_swedish_measured = yes
			te_cmg_scandinavian_swedish_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_scandinavian_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_scandinavian_danish_measured = yes
			te_cmg_scandinavian_danish_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_scandinavian_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_scandinavian_norwegian_measured = yes
			te_cmg_scandinavian_norwegian_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_scandinavian ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- east_slavic (russian, ukrainian, byelorussian) ----

# Any scope. The east_slavic merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_east_slavic_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_east_slavic
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the east_slavic merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_east_slavic_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:russian
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:ukrainian
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:byelorussian
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 2 }
	NOT = { te_cmg_east_slavic_result_switched = yes }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_east_slavic_core_ok = {
	OR = {
		te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_measured = yes
		te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_measured = yes
		te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_measured = yes
		te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. russian is free for the east_slavic merge.
te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. russian passes its gates for the east_slavic merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_east_slavic_russian ?= 1
	te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_russian }
}

# Country scope. russian joined the east_slavic merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_russian ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_russian
}

# Country scope. russian (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the east_slavic merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_east_slavic_russian ?= 1
	te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_russian ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_russian }
	NOT = { te_cmg_east_slavic_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_east_slavic }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. ukrainian is free for the east_slavic merge.
te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. ukrainian passes its gates for the east_slavic merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_east_slavic_ukrainian ?= 1
	te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ukrainian }
}

# Country scope. ukrainian joined the east_slavic merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_ukrainian ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ukrainian
}

# Country scope. ukrainian (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the east_slavic merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_east_slavic_ukrainian ?= 1
	te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_ukrainian ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ukrainian }
	NOT = { te_cmg_east_slavic_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_east_slavic }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Country scope. ukrainian waits on a vanilla journal entry that some country holds (je_ukraine_cultural_renaissance, R37) and the merge
# has not yet waited te_cm_wait_cap_years: it doesn't join, and a core part doesn't let the merge start.
te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_waiting = {
	any_country = {
		has_journal_entry = je_ukraine_cultural_renaissance
	}
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_east_slavic
			trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_east_slavic } var:te_cm_wait_years_east_slavic >= te_cm_wait_cap_years }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. byelorussian is free for the east_slavic merge.
te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. byelorussian passes its gates for the east_slavic merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_east_slavic_byelorussian ?= 1
	te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_byelorussian }
}

# Country scope. byelorussian joined the east_slavic merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_byelorussian ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_byelorussian
}

# Country scope. byelorussian (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the east_slavic merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_east_slavic_byelorussian ?= 1
	te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_byelorussian ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_byelorussian }
	NOT = { te_cmg_east_slavic_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_east_slavic }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Country scope. byelorussian waits on a vanilla journal entry that some country holds (je_belarus_cultural_renaissance, R37) and the merge
# has not yet waited te_cm_wait_cap_years: it doesn't join, and a core part doesn't let the merge start.
te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_waiting = {
	any_country = {
		has_journal_entry = je_belarus_cultural_renaissance
	}
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_east_slavic
			trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_east_slavic } var:te_cm_wait_years_east_slavic >= te_cm_wait_cap_years }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the east_slavic merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_east_slavic_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_east_slavic_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_slavic
			global_var:te_cm_starter_east_slavic = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_east_slavic_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_russian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:russian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ukrainian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:ukrainian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_byelorussian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:byelorussian value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The east_slavic merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_east_slavic_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_slavic }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_slavic
			global_var:te_cm_starter_east_slavic = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the east_slavic merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_east_slavic (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_east_slavic_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_slavic
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_slavic
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_east_slavic
			te_cmg_east_slavic_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The east_slavic merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_east_slavic.
te_cmg_east_slavic_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_slavic
	global_var:te_cm_starter_east_slavic = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_slavic }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_east_slavic }
}

# Any scope. No part of the east_slavic merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_east_slavic_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_russian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_russian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_ukrainian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ukrainian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_byelorussian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_byelorussian }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The east_slavic merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_east_slavic_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_russian ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_russian
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_ukrainian ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ukrainian
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_byelorussian ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_byelorussian
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_russian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_russian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_ukrainian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ukrainian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_byelorussian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_byelorussian }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Everything the east_slavic merge needs to start except its waits on vanilla entries
# (each condition its own custom_tooltip). The census adds a wait year while this holds and an entry is open.
te_cmg_east_slavic_start_basics = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_result_not_merged_on
		NOT = { te_cmg_east_slavic_result_switched = yes }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_east_slavic_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:russian
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:ukrainian
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:byelorussian
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_east_slavic_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_measured = yes
			te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_east_slavic_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_measured = yes
			te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_east_slavic_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_measured = yes
			te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_east_slavic ?= 1
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the east_slavic merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_east_slavic_can_start = {
	te_cmg_east_slavic_start_basics = yes
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_east_slavic_wait_ukrainian_tt
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				any_country = {
					has_journal_entry = je_ukraine_cultural_renaissance
				}
			}
			AND = {
				has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_east_slavic
				trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_east_slavic } var:te_cm_wait_years_east_slavic >= te_cm_wait_cap_years }
			}
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_east_slavic_wait_byelorussian_tt
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				any_country = {
					has_journal_entry = je_belarus_cultural_renaissance
				}
			}
			AND = {
				has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_east_slavic
				trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_east_slavic } var:te_cm_wait_years_east_slavic >= te_cm_wait_cap_years }
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---- yugoslav (serb, croat, bosniak) ----

# Any scope. The yugoslav merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_yugoslav_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_yugoslav
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the yugoslav merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_yugoslav_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:serb
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:croat
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:bosniak
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 2 }
	NOT = { te_cmg_yugoslav_result_switched = yes }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_yugoslav_core_ok = {
	OR = {
		te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_measured = yes
		te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_yugoslav_croat_measured = yes
		te_cmg_yugoslav_croat_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_yugoslav_bosniak_measured = yes
		te_cmg_yugoslav_bosniak_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. serb is free for the yugoslav merge.
te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. serb passes its gates for the yugoslav merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_yugoslav_serb ?= 1
	te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_serb }
}

# Country scope. serb joined the yugoslav merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_serb ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_serb
}

# Country scope. serb (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the yugoslav merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_yugoslav_serb ?= 1
	te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_serb ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_serb }
	NOT = { te_cmg_yugoslav_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_yugoslav }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Country scope. serb waits on a vanilla journal entry that some country holds (je_the_balkan_league, R37) and the merge
# has not yet waited te_cm_wait_cap_years: it doesn't join, and a core part doesn't let the merge start.
te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_waiting = {
	any_country = {
		has_journal_entry = je_the_balkan_league
	}
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_yugoslav
			trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_yugoslav } var:te_cm_wait_years_yugoslav >= te_cm_wait_cap_years }
		}
	}
}

	has_variable = te_cm_years_yugoslav_slovene
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_yugoslav_slovene } var:te_cm_years_yugoslav_slovene >= te_cm_years_tier3 }
}

	NOT = { te_cmg_yugoslav_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_yugoslav }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	te_cmg_yugoslav_slovene_years_met = yes
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_yugoslav_slovene ?= 1
}

# Country scope. bulgarian (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the yugoslav merge now: it has not switched

	var:te_cm_ok_yugoslav_bulgarian ?= 1
	te_cmg_yugoslav_bulgarian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_bulgarian ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian }
	NOT = { te_cmg_yugoslav_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_yugoslav }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	te_cmg_yugoslav_bulgarian_years_met = yes
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_yugoslav_bulgarian ?= 1
}

# Country scope. bulgarian waits on a vanilla journal entry that some country holds (je_the_balkan_league, R37) and the merge
# has not yet waited te_cm_wait_cap_years: it doesn't join, and a core part doesn't let the merge start.
te_cmg_yugoslav_bulgarian_waiting = {
	any_country = {
		has_journal_entry = je_the_balkan_league
	}
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_yugoslav
			trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_yugoslav } var:te_cm_wait_years_yugoslav >= te_cm_wait_cap_years }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the yugoslav merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_yugoslav_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_yugoslav_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_yugoslav
			global_var:te_cm_starter_yugoslav = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_yugoslav_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_serb }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:serb value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_croat }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:croat value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bosniak }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:bosniak value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovene }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:slovene value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:bulgarian value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The yugoslav merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_yugoslav_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_yugoslav }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_yugoslav
			global_var:te_cm_starter_yugoslav = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the yugoslav merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_yugoslav (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_yugoslav_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_yugoslav
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_yugoslav
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_yugoslav
			te_cmg_yugoslav_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The yugoslav merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_yugoslav.
te_cmg_yugoslav_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_yugoslav
	global_var:te_cm_starter_yugoslav = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_yugoslav }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_yugoslav }
}

# Any scope. No part of the yugoslav merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_yugoslav_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_serb ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_serb }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_croat ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_croat }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_bosniak ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bosniak }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_slovene ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovene }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_bulgarian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The yugoslav merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_yugoslav_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_serb ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_serb
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_croat ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_croat
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_bosniak ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bosniak
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_serb ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_serb }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_croat ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_croat }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_bosniak ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bosniak }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Everything the yugoslav merge needs to start except its waits on vanilla entries
# (each condition its own custom_tooltip). The census adds a wait year while this holds and an entry is open.
te_cmg_yugoslav_start_basics = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_result_not_merged_on
		NOT = { te_cmg_yugoslav_result_switched = yes }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_yugoslav_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:serb
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:croat
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:bosniak
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_yugoslav_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_measured = yes
			te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_yugoslav_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_yugoslav_croat_measured = yes
			te_cmg_yugoslav_croat_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_yugoslav_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_yugoslav_bosniak_measured = yes
			te_cmg_yugoslav_bosniak_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_yugoslav ?= 1
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the yugoslav merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_yugoslav_can_start = {
	te_cmg_yugoslav_start_basics = yes
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_yugoslav_wait_serb_tt
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				any_country = {
					has_journal_entry = je_the_balkan_league
				}
			}
			AND = {
				has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_yugoslav
				trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_yugoslav } var:te_cm_wait_years_yugoslav >= te_cm_wait_cap_years }
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---- czechoslovak (czech, slovak) ----

# Any scope. The czechoslovak merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_czechoslovak
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the czechoslovak merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_czechoslovak_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:czech
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:slovak
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 2 }
	NOT = { te_cmg_czechoslovak_result_switched = yes }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_core_ok = {
	OR = {
		te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_measured = yes
		te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_measured = yes
		te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. czech is free for the czechoslovak merge.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. czech passes its gates for the czechoslovak merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_czechoslovak_czech ?= 1
	te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_czech }
}

# Country scope. czech joined the czechoslovak merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_czech ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_czech
}

# Country scope. czech (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the czechoslovak merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_czechoslovak_czech ?= 1
	te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_czech ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_czech }
	NOT = { te_cmg_czechoslovak_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_czechoslovak }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. slovak is free for the czechoslovak merge.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. slovak passes its gates for the czechoslovak merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_czechoslovak_slovak ?= 1
	te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovak }
}

# Country scope. slovak joined the czechoslovak merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_slovak ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovak
}

# Country scope. slovak (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the czechoslovak merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_czechoslovak_slovak ?= 1
	te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_slovak ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovak }
	NOT = { te_cmg_czechoslovak_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_czechoslovak }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. sorb is free for the czechoslovak merge.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_sorb_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. sorb passes its gates for the czechoslovak merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_czechoslovak_sorb_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_czechoslovak_sorb ?= 1
	te_cmg_czechoslovak_sorb_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sorb }
}

# Country scope. sorb joined the czechoslovak merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_sorb_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_sorb ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sorb
}

# Country scope. sorb (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the czechoslovak merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_sorb_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_czechoslovak_sorb ?= 1
	te_cmg_czechoslovak_sorb_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_sorb ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sorb }
	NOT = { te_cmg_czechoslovak_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_czechoslovak }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_czechoslovak_sorb ?= 1
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the czechoslovak merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_czechoslovak_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_czechoslovak
			global_var:te_cm_starter_czechoslovak = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_czechoslovak_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_czech }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:czech value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovak }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:slovak value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sorb }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:sorb value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The czechoslovak merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_czechoslovak }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_czechoslovak
			global_var:te_cm_starter_czechoslovak = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the czechoslovak merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_czechoslovak (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_czechoslovak
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_czechoslovak
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_czechoslovak
			te_cmg_czechoslovak_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The czechoslovak merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_czechoslovak.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_czechoslovak
	global_var:te_cm_starter_czechoslovak = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_czechoslovak }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_czechoslovak }
}

# Any scope. No part of the czechoslovak merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_czech ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_czech }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_slovak ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovak }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_sorb ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sorb }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The czechoslovak merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_czech ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_czech
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_slovak ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovak
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_czech ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_czech }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_slovak ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovak }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the czechoslovak merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_result_not_merged_on
		NOT = { te_cmg_czechoslovak_result_switched = yes }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_czechoslovak_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:czech
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:slovak
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_czechoslovak_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_measured = yes
			te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_czechoslovak_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_measured = yes
			te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_czechoslovak ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- hungarian (hungarian, szekely) ----

# Any scope. The hungarian merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_hungarian_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hungarian
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the hungarian merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_hungarian_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:hungarian
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:szekely
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_hungarian_core_ok = {
	te_cmg_hungarian_hungarian_measured = yes
	OR = {
		te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_measured = yes
		te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. hungarian is free for the hungarian merge.
te_cmg_hungarian_hungarian_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. hungarian passes its gates for the hungarian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_hungarian_hungarian_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_hungarian_hungarian ?= 1
	te_cmg_hungarian_hungarian_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hungarian }
}

# Country scope. hungarian (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the hungarian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_hungarian_hungarian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_hungarian_hungarian ?= 1
	te_cmg_hungarian_hungarian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_hungarian_hungarian ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hungarian }
	NOT = { te_cmg_hungarian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. szekely is free for the hungarian merge.
te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. szekely passes its gates for the hungarian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_hungarian_szekely ?= 1
	te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_szekely }
}

# Country scope. szekely joined the hungarian merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_hungarian_szekely ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_szekely
}

# Country scope. szekely (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the hungarian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_hungarian_szekely ?= 1
	te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_hungarian_szekely ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_szekely }
	NOT = { te_cmg_hungarian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the hungarian merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_hungarian_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_hungarian_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_hungarian
			global_var:te_cm_starter_hungarian = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_hungarian_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_szekely }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:szekely value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The hungarian merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_hungarian_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_hungarian }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_hungarian
			global_var:te_cm_starter_hungarian = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the hungarian merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_hungarian (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_hungarian_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_hungarian
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_hungarian
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_hungarian
			te_cmg_hungarian_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The hungarian merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_hungarian.
te_cmg_hungarian_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_hungarian
	global_var:te_cm_starter_hungarian = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_hungarian }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_hungarian }
}

# Any scope. No part of the hungarian merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_hungarian_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_hungarian_szekely ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_szekely }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The hungarian merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_hungarian_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_hungarian_szekely ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_szekely
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_hungarian_szekely ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_szekely }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the hungarian merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_hungarian_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_hungarian_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:hungarian
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:szekely
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_hungarian_core_1_tt
		te_cmg_hungarian_hungarian_measured = yes
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_hungarian_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_measured = yes
			te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_hungarian ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- dutch (dutch, flemish) ----

# Any scope. The dutch merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_dutch_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dutch
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the dutch merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_dutch_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:dutch
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:flemish
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_dutch ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_dutch_core_ok = {
	te_cmg_dutch_dutch_measured = yes
	OR = {
		te_cmg_dutch_flemish_measured = yes
		te_cmg_dutch_flemish_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. dutch is free for the dutch merge.
te_cmg_dutch_dutch_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. dutch passes its gates for the dutch merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).

	var:te_cm_ok_dutch_dutch ?= 1
	te_cmg_dutch_dutch_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dutch }
}

# Country scope. dutch (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the dutch merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_dutch_dutch_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_dutch_dutch ?= 1
	te_cmg_dutch_dutch_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_dutch_dutch ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dutch }
	NOT = { te_cmg_dutch_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
