	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_finnish
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_finnish
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_finnish
			te_cmg_finnish_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The finnish merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_finnish.
te_cmg_finnish_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_finnish ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_finnish ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_finnish
	global_var:te_cm_starter_finnish = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_finnish }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_finnish }
}

# Any scope. No part of the finnish merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_finnish_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_finnish_karelian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_karelian }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The finnish merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_finnish_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_finnish_karelian ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_karelian
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_finnish_karelian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_karelian }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the finnish merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_finnish_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_finnish ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_finnish ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_finnish_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:finnish
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:karelian
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_finnish_core_1_tt
		te_cmg_finnish_finnish_measured = yes
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_finnish_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_finnish_karelian_measured = yes
			te_cmg_finnish_karelian_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_finnish ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- french (french, wallonian, occitan) ----

# Any scope. The french merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_french_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the french merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_french_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:french
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:wallonian
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:occitan
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 2 }
	NOT = { te_cmg_french_result_switched = yes }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_french_core_ok = {
	te_cmg_french_french_measured = yes
	OR = {
		te_cmg_french_wallonian_measured = yes
		te_cmg_french_wallonian_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_french_occitan_measured = yes
		te_cmg_french_occitan_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. french is free for the french merge.
te_cmg_french_french_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_french ?= 28 }
}

# Country scope. french passes its gates for the french merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_french_french_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_french_french ?= 1
	te_cmg_french_french_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french }
}

# Country scope. french (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the french merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_french_french_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_french_french ?= 1
	te_cmg_french_french_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_french_french ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french }
	NOT = { te_cmg_french_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_french }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. wallonian is free for the french merge.
te_cmg_french_wallonian_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. wallonian passes its gates for the french merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_french_wallonian_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_french_wallonian ?= 1
	te_cmg_french_wallonian_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_wallonian }
}

# Country scope. wallonian joined the french merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_french_wallonian_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_french_wallonian ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_wallonian
}

# Country scope. wallonian (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the french merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_french_wallonian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_french_wallonian ?= 1
	te_cmg_french_wallonian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_french_wallonian ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_wallonian }
	NOT = { te_cmg_french_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_french }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. occitan is free for the french merge.
te_cmg_french_occitan_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. occitan passes its gates for the french merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_french_occitan_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_french_occitan ?= 1
	te_cmg_french_occitan_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_occitan }
}

# Country scope. occitan joined the french merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_french_occitan_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_french_occitan ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_occitan
}

# Country scope. occitan (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the french merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_french_occitan_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_french_occitan ?= 1
	te_cmg_french_occitan_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_french_occitan ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_occitan }
	NOT = { te_cmg_french_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_french }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. catalan is free for the french merge.
te_cmg_french_catalan_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. catalan passes its gates for the french merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_french_catalan_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_french_catalan ?= 1
	te_cmg_french_catalan_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_catalan }
}

# Country scope. catalan (tier 2) has spent the years together its tier asks for.
te_cmg_french_catalan_years_met = {
	has_variable = te_cm_years_french_catalan
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_french_catalan } var:te_cm_years_french_catalan >= te_cm_years_tier3 }
}

# Country scope. catalan joined the french merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_french_catalan_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_french_catalan ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_catalan
}

# Country scope. catalan (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the french merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_french_catalan_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_french_catalan ?= 1
	te_cmg_french_catalan_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_french_catalan ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_catalan }
	NOT = { te_cmg_french_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_french }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	te_cmg_french_catalan_years_met = yes
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_french_catalan ?= 1
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the french merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_french_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_french_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_french
			global_var:te_cm_starter_french = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_french_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_wallonian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:wallonian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_occitan }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:occitan value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_catalan }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:catalan value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The french merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_french_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_french }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_french
			global_var:te_cm_starter_french = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the french merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_french (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_french_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_french
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_french
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_french
			te_cmg_french_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The french merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_french.
te_cmg_french_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_french
	global_var:te_cm_starter_french = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_french }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_french }
}

# Any scope. No part of the french merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_french_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_french_wallonian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_wallonian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_french_occitan ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_occitan }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_french_catalan ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_catalan }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The french merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_french_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_french_wallonian ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_wallonian
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_french_occitan ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_occitan
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_french_wallonian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_wallonian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_french_occitan ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_occitan }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the french merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_french_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_result_not_merged_on
		NOT = { te_cmg_french_result_switched = yes }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_french_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:french
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:wallonian
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:occitan
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_french_core_1_tt
		te_cmg_french_french_measured = yes
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_french_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_french_wallonian_measured = yes
			te_cmg_french_wallonian_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_french_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_french_occitan_measured = yes
			te_cmg_french_occitan_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_french ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- british (british, scottish) ----

# Any scope. The british merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_british_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british
}

# Any scope. Every core slot of the british merge that another merge can take still has an alternative that has not
# switched there: unswitched, or joined to this merge (and so switched here). Once a higher merge has switched
# a core part, the british merge can never start: it is no candidate, and a candidate's entry ends.
te_cmg_british_core_left = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish }
		global_var:te_cm_joined_british_scottish ?= 1
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the british merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_british_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:british
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:scottish
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 2 }
	NOT = { te_cmg_british_result_switched = yes }
	te_cmg_british_core_left = yes
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_british_core_ok = {
	te_cmg_british_british_measured = yes
	OR = {
		te_cmg_british_scottish_measured = yes
		te_cmg_british_scottish_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. british is free for the british merge.
te_cmg_british_british_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_british ?= 13 }
}

# Country scope. british passes its gates for the british merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_british_british_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_british_british ?= 1
	te_cmg_british_british_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british }
}

# Country scope. british (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the british merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_british_british_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_british_british ?= 1
	te_cmg_british_british_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_british_british ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british }
	NOT = { te_cmg_british_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_british }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. scottish is free for the british merge.
te_cmg_british_scottish_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_scottish ?= 13 }
}

# Country scope. scottish passes its gates for the british merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_british_scottish_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_british_scottish ?= 1
	te_cmg_british_scottish_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish }
}

# Country scope. scottish joined the british merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_british_scottish_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_british_scottish ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish
}

# Country scope. scottish (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the british merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_british_scottish_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_british_scottish ?= 1
	te_cmg_british_scottish_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_british_scottish ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish }
	NOT = { te_cmg_british_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_british }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the british merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_british_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_british_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_british
			global_var:te_cm_starter_british = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_british_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:scottish value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The british merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_british_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_british }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_british
			global_var:te_cm_starter_british = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the british merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_british (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_british_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_british
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_british
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_british
			te_cmg_british_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The british merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_british.
te_cmg_british_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_british
	global_var:te_cm_starter_british = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_british }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_british }
}

# Any scope. No part of the british merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_british_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_british_scottish ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The british merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_british_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_british_scottish ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_british_scottish ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the british merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_british_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_result_not_merged_on
		NOT = { te_cmg_british_result_switched = yes }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_british_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:british
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:scottish
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_british_core_1_tt
		te_cmg_british_british_measured = yes
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_british_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_british_scottish_measured = yes
			te_cmg_british_scottish_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_british ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- american (yankee, dixie) ----

# Any scope. The american merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_american_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_american
}

# Any scope. Every core slot of the american merge that another merge can take still has an alternative that has not
# switched there: unswitched, or joined to this merge (and so switched here). Once a higher merge has switched
# a core part, the american merge can never start: it is no candidate, and a candidate's entry ends.
te_cmg_american_core_left = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
		global_var:te_cm_joined_american_yankee ?= 1
	}
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie }
		global_var:te_cm_joined_american_dixie ?= 1
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the american merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_american_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:yankee
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:dixie
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 2 }
	NOT = { te_cmg_american_result_switched = yes }
	te_cmg_american_core_left = yes
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_american_core_ok = {
	OR = {
		te_cmg_american_yankee_measured = yes
		te_cmg_american_yankee_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_american_dixie_measured = yes
		te_cmg_american_dixie_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. yankee is free for the american merge.
te_cmg_american_yankee_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_yankee ?= 13 }
}

# Country scope. yankee passes its gates for the american merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_american_yankee_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_american_yankee ?= 1
	te_cmg_american_yankee_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
}

# Country scope. yankee joined the american merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_american_yankee_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_american_yankee ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee
}

# Country scope. yankee (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the american merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_american_yankee_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_american_yankee ?= 1
	te_cmg_american_yankee_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_american_yankee ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
	NOT = { te_cmg_american_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_american }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. dixie is free for the american merge.
te_cmg_american_dixie_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_dixie ?= 13 }
}

# Country scope. dixie passes its gates for the american merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_american_dixie_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_american_dixie ?= 1
	te_cmg_american_dixie_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie }
}

# Country scope. dixie joined the american merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_american_dixie_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_american_dixie ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie
}

# Country scope. dixie (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the american merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_american_dixie_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_american_dixie ?= 1
	te_cmg_american_dixie_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_american_dixie ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie }
	NOT = { te_cmg_american_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_american }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Country scope. dixie waits on a vanilla journal entry that some country holds (je_acw_reincorporate, R37) and the merge
# has not yet waited te_cm_wait_cap_years: it doesn't join, and a core part doesn't let the merge start.
te_cmg_american_dixie_waiting = {
	any_country = {
		has_journal_entry = je_acw_reincorporate
	}
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_american
			trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_american } var:te_cm_wait_years_american >= te_cm_wait_cap_years }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. afro_american is free for the american merge.
te_cmg_american_afro_american_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_afro_american ?= 13 }
}

# Country scope. afro_american passes its gates for the american merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_american_afro_american_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_american_afro_american ?= 1
	te_cmg_american_afro_american_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american }
}

# Country scope. afro_american (tier 1b) has spent the years together its tier asks for.
te_cmg_american_afro_american_years_met = {
	has_variable = te_cm_years_american_afro_american
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_american_afro_american } var:te_cm_years_american_afro_american >= te_cm_years_tier2 }
}

# Country scope. afro_american joined the american merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_american_afro_american_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_american_afro_american ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american
}

# Country scope. afro_american (tier 1b) passes its gates and can join the american merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_american_afro_american_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_american_afro_american ?= 1
	te_cmg_american_afro_american_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_american_afro_american ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american }
	NOT = { te_cmg_american_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_american }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	te_cmg_american_afro_american_years_met = yes
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_american_afro_american ?= 1
}

# Country scope. afro_american waits on a vanilla journal entry that some country holds (je_acw_equality, R37) and the merge
# has not yet waited te_cm_wait_cap_years: it doesn't join, and a core part doesn't let the merge start.
te_cmg_american_afro_american_waiting = {
	any_country = {
		has_journal_entry = je_acw_equality
	}
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_american
			trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_american } var:te_cm_wait_years_american >= te_cm_wait_cap_years }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the american merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_american_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_american_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_american
			global_var:te_cm_starter_american = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_american_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:yankee value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:dixie value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:afro_american value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The american merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_american_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_american }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_american
			global_var:te_cm_starter_american = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the american merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_american (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_american_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_american
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_american
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_american
			te_cmg_american_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The american merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_american.
te_cmg_american_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_american
	global_var:te_cm_starter_american = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_american }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_american }
}

# Any scope. No part of the american merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_american_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_american_yankee ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_american_dixie ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_american_afro_american ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The american merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_american_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_american_yankee ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_american_dixie ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_american_yankee ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_american_dixie ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Everything the american merge needs to start except its waits on vanilla entries
# (each condition its own custom_tooltip). The census adds a wait year while this holds and an entry is open.
te_cmg_american_start_basics = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_result_not_merged_on
		NOT = { te_cmg_american_result_switched = yes }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_american_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:yankee
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:dixie
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_american_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_american_yankee_measured = yes
			te_cmg_american_yankee_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_american_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_american_dixie_measured = yes
			te_cmg_american_dixie_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_american ?= 1
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the american merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_american_can_start = {
	te_cmg_american_start_basics = yes
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_american_wait_dixie_tt
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				any_country = {
					has_journal_entry = je_acw_reincorporate
				}
			}
			AND = {
				has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_american
				trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_american } var:te_cm_wait_years_american >= te_cm_wait_cap_years }
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---- anglophone (british, yankee/cm_american) ----

# Any scope. The anglophone merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_anglophone_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_anglophone
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the anglophone merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_anglophone_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:british
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:yankee
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_american
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_anglophone_core_ok = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			te_cmg_anglophone_british_measured = yes
			te_cmg_anglophone_british_years_met = yes
		}
		te_cmg_anglophone_british_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_measured = yes
			te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_years_met = yes
		}
		te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_switched_in = yes
		AND = {
			te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_measured = yes
			te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_years_met = yes
		}
		te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. british is free for the anglophone merge.
te_cmg_anglophone_british_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_british ?= 11 }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 2
			te_cmg_british_all_switched = yes
		}
		NOR = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_british_scottish ?= 1
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. british passes its gates for the anglophone merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_anglophone_british_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_british ?= 1
	te_cmg_anglophone_british_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british }
}

# Country scope. british (tier 1b) has spent the years together its tier asks for.
te_cmg_anglophone_british_years_met = {
	has_variable = te_cm_years_anglophone_british
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_anglophone_british } var:te_cm_years_anglophone_british >= te_cm_years_tier2 }
}

# Country scope. british joined the anglophone merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_anglophone_british_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_british ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british
}

# Country scope. british (tier 1b) passes its gates and can join the anglophone merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_anglophone_british_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_british ?= 1
	te_cmg_anglophone_british_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_british ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british }
	NOT = { te_cmg_anglophone_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	te_cmg_anglophone_british_years_met = yes
}

# Any scope. yankee is free for the anglophone merge.
te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_yankee ?= 12 }
}

# Country scope. yankee passes its gates for the anglophone merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_yankee ?= 1
	te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
}

# Country scope. yankee (tier 1b) has spent the years together its tier asks for.
te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_years_met = {
	has_variable = te_cm_years_anglophone_yankee
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_anglophone_yankee } var:te_cm_years_anglophone_yankee >= te_cm_years_tier2 }
}

# Country scope. yankee joined the anglophone merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_yankee ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee
}

# Country scope. yankee (tier 1b) passes its gates and can join the anglophone merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_yankee ?= 1
	te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_yankee ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
	NOT = { te_cmg_anglophone_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_years_met = yes
}

	te_cmg_anglophone_dixie_available = yes

	var:te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone_dixie ?= 1
}

# Country scope. dixie waits on a vanilla journal entry that some country holds (je_acw_reincorporate, R37) and the merge
# has not yet waited te_cm_wait_cap_years: it doesn't join, and a core part doesn't let the merge start.
te_cmg_anglophone_dixie_waiting = {
	any_country = {
		has_journal_entry = je_acw_reincorporate
	}
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_anglophone
			trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_anglophone } var:te_cm_wait_years_anglophone >= te_cm_wait_cap_years }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. afro_american is free for the anglophone merge.
te_cmg_anglophone_afro_american_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_afro_american ?= 12 }
}

	te_cmg_anglophone_afro_american_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american }
}

	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_anglophone_afro_american } var:te_cm_years_anglophone_afro_american >= te_cm_years_tier2 }
}

	global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_afro_american ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american
}

# Country scope. afro_american (tier 1b) passes its gates and can join the anglophone merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_anglophone_afro_american_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_afro_american ?= 1
	te_cmg_anglophone_afro_american_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_afro_american ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american }
	NOT = { te_cmg_anglophone_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	te_cmg_anglophone_afro_american_years_met = yes
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone_afro_american ?= 1
}

# Country scope. afro_american waits on a vanilla journal entry that some country holds (je_acw_equality, R37) and the merge
# has not yet waited te_cm_wait_cap_years: it doesn't join, and a core part doesn't let the merge start.
te_cmg_anglophone_afro_american_waiting = {
	any_country = {
		has_journal_entry = je_acw_equality
	}
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_anglophone
			trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_anglophone } var:te_cm_wait_years_anglophone >= te_cm_wait_cap_years }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the anglophone merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_anglophone_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_anglophone_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_anglophone
			global_var:te_cm_starter_anglophone = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_anglophone_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:british value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:yankee value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_american }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:cm_american value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_anglo_canadian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:anglo_canadian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_australian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:australian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:scottish value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:dixie value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:afro_american value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The anglophone merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_anglophone_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_anglophone }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_anglophone
			global_var:te_cm_starter_anglophone = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the anglophone merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_anglophone (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_anglophone_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_anglophone
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_anglophone
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_anglophone
			te_cmg_anglophone_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The anglophone merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_anglophone.
te_cmg_anglophone_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_anglophone
	global_var:te_cm_starter_anglophone = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_anglophone }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_anglophone }
}

# Any scope. No part of the anglophone merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_anglophone_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_british ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_yankee ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_cm_american ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_american }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_anglo_canadian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_anglo_canadian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_australian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_australian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_scottish ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_dixie ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_afro_american ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The anglophone merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_anglophone_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_british ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_yankee ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_cm_american ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_american
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_british ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_yankee ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_cm_american ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_american }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the anglophone merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_anglophone_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_anglophone_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:british
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:yankee
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_american
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_2
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_anglophone_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_british_measured = yes
				te_cmg_anglophone_british_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_anglophone_british_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_anglophone_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_measured = yes
				te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_switched_in = yes
			AND = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_measured = yes
				te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- brazilian (brazilian, nordestino, paulista, amazonic, sulista) ----

# Any scope. The brazilian merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_brazilian_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_brazilian
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the brazilian merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_brazilian_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:nordestino
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:paulista
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:amazonic
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:sulista
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_brazilian ?= 2 }
	NOT = { has_dlc_feature = rp1_content }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_brazilian_core_ok = {
	te_cmg_brazilian_brazilian_measured = yes
	OR = {
		te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_measured = yes
		te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_measured = yes
		te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_measured = yes
		te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_measured = yes
		te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. brazilian is free for the brazilian merge.
te_cmg_brazilian_brazilian_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. brazilian passes its gates for the brazilian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_brazilian_brazilian_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_brazilian_brazilian ?= 1
	te_cmg_brazilian_brazilian_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_brazilian }
}

# Country scope. brazilian (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the brazilian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_brazilian_brazilian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_brazilian_brazilian ?= 1
	te_cmg_brazilian_brazilian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_brazilian ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_brazilian }
	NOT = { te_cmg_brazilian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. nordestino is free for the brazilian merge.
te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. nordestino passes its gates for the brazilian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).

	te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nordestino }
}

# Country scope. nordestino joined the brazilian merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_nordestino ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nordestino
}

# Country scope. nordestino (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the brazilian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_brazilian_nordestino ?= 1
	te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_nordestino ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nordestino }
	NOT = { te_cmg_brazilian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}
