# Any scope. afro_brazilian is free for the brazilian merge.
te_cmg_brazilian_afro_brazilian_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. afro_brazilian passes its gates for the brazilian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_brazilian_afro_brazilian_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_brazilian_afro_brazilian ?= 1
	te_cmg_brazilian_afro_brazilian_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_brazilian }
}

# Country scope. afro_brazilian (tier 1b) has spent the years together its tier asks for.
te_cmg_brazilian_afro_brazilian_years_met = {
	has_variable = te_cm_years_brazilian_afro_brazilian
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_brazilian_afro_brazilian } var:te_cm_years_brazilian_afro_brazilian >= te_cm_years_tier2 }
}

# Country scope. afro_brazilian joined the brazilian merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_brazilian_afro_brazilian_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_afro_brazilian ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_brazilian
}

# Country scope. afro_brazilian (tier 1b) passes its gates and can join the brazilian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_brazilian_afro_brazilian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_brazilian_afro_brazilian ?= 1
	te_cmg_brazilian_afro_brazilian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_afro_brazilian ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_brazilian }
	NOT = { te_cmg_brazilian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	te_cmg_brazilian_afro_brazilian_years_met = yes
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian_afro_brazilian ?= 1
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the brazilian merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_brazilian_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_brazilian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_brazilian ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_brazilian_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_brazilian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_brazilian ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_brazilian
			global_var:te_cm_starter_brazilian = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_brazilian_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nordestino }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:nordestino value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paulista }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:paulista value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_amazonic }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:amazonic value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sulista }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:sulista value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_brazilian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:afro_brazilian value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The brazilian merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_brazilian_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_brazilian }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_brazilian
			global_var:te_cm_starter_brazilian = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the brazilian merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_brazilian (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_brazilian_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_brazilian ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_brazilian ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_brazilian
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_brazilian
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_brazilian
			te_cmg_brazilian_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The brazilian merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_brazilian.
te_cmg_brazilian_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_brazilian ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_brazilian ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_brazilian
	global_var:te_cm_starter_brazilian = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_brazilian }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_brazilian }
}

# Any scope. No part of the brazilian merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_brazilian_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_nordestino ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nordestino }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_paulista ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paulista }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_amazonic ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_amazonic }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_sulista ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sulista }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_afro_brazilian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_brazilian }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The brazilian merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_brazilian_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_nordestino ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nordestino
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_paulista ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paulista
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_amazonic ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_amazonic
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_sulista ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sulista
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_nordestino ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nordestino }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_paulista ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paulista }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_amazonic ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_amazonic }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_sulista ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sulista }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the brazilian merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_brazilian_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_brazilian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_brazilian ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_dlc_off_rp1_content
		NOT = { has_dlc_feature = rp1_content }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_brazilian_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:nordestino
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:paulista
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:amazonic
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:sulista
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_brazilian_core_1_tt
		te_cmg_brazilian_brazilian_measured = yes
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_brazilian_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_measured = yes
			te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_brazilian_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_measured = yes
			te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_brazilian_core_4_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_measured = yes
			te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_brazilian_core_5_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_measured = yes
			te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- platine (platinean, argentine, uruguayan, paraguayan) ----

# Any scope. The platine merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_platine_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_platine
}

# Any scope. Every core slot of the platine merge that another merge can take still has an alternative that has not
# switched there: unswitched, or joined to this merge (and so switched here). Once a higher merge has switched
# a core part, the platine merge can never start: it is no candidate, and a candidate's entry ends.
te_cmg_platine_core_left = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean }
		global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_platinean ?= 1
	}
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine }
		global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_argentine ?= 1
	}
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan }
		global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_uruguayan ?= 1
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the platine merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_platine_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:platinean
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:argentine
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:uruguayan
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:paraguayan
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 2 }
	NOT = { te_cmg_platine_result_switched = yes }
	te_cmg_platine_core_left = yes
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_platine_core_ok = {
	OR = {
		te_cmg_platine_platinean_measured = yes
		te_cmg_platine_platinean_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_platine_argentine_measured = yes
		te_cmg_platine_argentine_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_measured = yes
		te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_measured = yes
		te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. platinean is free for the platine merge.
te_cmg_platine_platinean_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_platinean ?= 28 }
}

# Country scope. platinean passes its gates for the platine merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_platine_platinean_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_platine_platinean ?= 1
	te_cmg_platine_platinean_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean }
}

# Country scope. platinean joined the platine merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_platine_platinean_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_platinean ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean
}

# Country scope. platinean (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the platine merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_platine_platinean_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_platine_platinean ?= 1
	te_cmg_platine_platinean_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_platinean ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean }
	NOT = { te_cmg_platine_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_platine }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. argentine is free for the platine merge.
te_cmg_platine_argentine_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_argentine ?= 28 }
}

# Country scope. argentine passes its gates for the platine merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_platine_argentine_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_platine_argentine ?= 1
	te_cmg_platine_argentine_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine }
}

# Country scope. argentine joined the platine merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_platine_argentine_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_argentine ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine
}

# Country scope. argentine (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the platine merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_platine_argentine_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_platine_argentine ?= 1
	te_cmg_platine_argentine_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_argentine ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine }
	NOT = { te_cmg_platine_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_platine }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. uruguayan is free for the platine merge.
te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_uruguayan ?= 28 }
}

# Country scope. uruguayan passes its gates for the platine merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_platine_uruguayan ?= 1
	te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan }
}

# Country scope. uruguayan joined the platine merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_uruguayan ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan
}

# Country scope. uruguayan (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the platine merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_platine_uruguayan ?= 1
	te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_uruguayan ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan }
	NOT = { te_cmg_platine_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_platine }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. paraguayan is free for the platine merge.
te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. paraguayan passes its gates for the platine merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_platine_paraguayan ?= 1
	te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paraguayan }
}

# Country scope. paraguayan joined the platine merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_paraguayan ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paraguayan
}

# Country scope. paraguayan (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the platine merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_platine_paraguayan ?= 1
	te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_paraguayan ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paraguayan }
	NOT = { te_cmg_platine_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_platine }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the platine merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_platine_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_platine_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_platine
			global_var:te_cm_starter_platine = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_platine_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:platinean value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:argentine value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:uruguayan value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paraguayan }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:paraguayan value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The platine merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_platine_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_platine }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_platine
			global_var:te_cm_starter_platine = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the platine merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_platine (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_platine_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_platine
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_platine
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_platine
			te_cmg_platine_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The platine merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_platine.
te_cmg_platine_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_platine
	global_var:te_cm_starter_platine = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_platine }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_platine }
}

# Any scope. No part of the platine merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_platine_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_platinean ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_argentine ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_uruguayan ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_paraguayan ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paraguayan }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The platine merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_platine_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_platinean ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_argentine ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_uruguayan ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_paraguayan ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paraguayan
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_platinean ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_argentine ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_uruguayan ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_platine_paraguayan ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paraguayan }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the platine merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_platine_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_result_not_merged_on
		NOT = { te_cmg_platine_result_switched = yes }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_platine_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:platinean
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:argentine
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:uruguayan
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:paraguayan
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_platine_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_platine_platinean_measured = yes
			te_cmg_platine_platinean_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_platine_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_platine_argentine_measured = yes
			te_cmg_platine_argentine_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_platine_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_measured = yes
			te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_platine_core_4_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_measured = yes
			te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_platine ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- andean (north_andean, south_andean, peruvian, bolivian) ----

# Any scope. The andean merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_andean_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_andean
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the andean merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_andean_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_andean
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_andean
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:peruvian
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:bolivian
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_andean ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_andean_core_ok = {
	OR = {
		te_cmg_andean_north_andean_measured = yes
		te_cmg_andean_north_andean_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_andean_south_andean_measured = yes
		te_cmg_andean_south_andean_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_andean_peruvian_measured = yes
		te_cmg_andean_peruvian_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_andean_bolivian_measured = yes
		te_cmg_andean_bolivian_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. north_andean is free for the andean merge.
te_cmg_andean_north_andean_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. north_andean passes its gates for the andean merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_andean_north_andean_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_andean_north_andean ?= 1
	te_cmg_andean_north_andean_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_andean }
}

# Country scope. north_andean joined the andean merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_andean_north_andean_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_andean_north_andean ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_andean
}

# Country scope. north_andean (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the andean merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_andean_north_andean_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_andean_north_andean ?= 1
	te_cmg_andean_north_andean_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_andean_north_andean ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_andean }
	NOT = { te_cmg_andean_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. south_andean is free for the andean merge.

	always = yes
}

# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a

				global_var:te_cm_state_andean ?= 2

					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_andean }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:north_andean value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_andean }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:south_andean value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_peruvian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:peruvian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bolivian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:bolivian value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

		}

	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_andean }
}

# Any scope. No part of the andean merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_andean_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_andean_north_andean ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_andean }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_andean_south_andean ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_andean }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_andean_peruvian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_peruvian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_andean_bolivian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bolivian }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The andean merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_andean_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_andean_north_andean ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_andean
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_andean_south_andean ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_andean
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_andean_peruvian ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_peruvian
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_andean_bolivian ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bolivian
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_andean_north_andean ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_andean }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_andean_south_andean ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_andean }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_andean_peruvian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_peruvian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_andean_bolivian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bolivian }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the andean merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_andean_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_andean ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_andean ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_andean_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_andean
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_andean
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:peruvian
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:bolivian
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_andean_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_andean_north_andean_measured = yes
			te_cmg_andean_north_andean_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_andean_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_andean_south_andean_measured = yes
			te_cmg_andean_south_andean_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_andean_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_andean_peruvian_measured = yes
			te_cmg_andean_peruvian_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_andean_core_4_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_andean_bolivian_measured = yes
			te_cmg_andean_bolivian_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_andean ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- gran_colombian (colombian, venezuelan, ecuadorian) ----

# Any scope. The gran_colombian merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_gran_colombian
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the gran_colombian merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_gran_colombian_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:colombian
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:venezuelan
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:ecuadorian
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_core_ok = {
	OR = {
		te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_measured = yes
		te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_measured = yes
		te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_measured = yes
		te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. colombian is free for the gran_colombian merge.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. colombian passes its gates for the gran_colombian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_gran_colombian_colombian ?= 1
	te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_colombian }
}

# Country scope. colombian joined the gran_colombian merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_colombian ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_colombian
}

# Country scope. colombian (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the gran_colombian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_gran_colombian_colombian ?= 1
	te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_colombian ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_colombian }
	NOT = { te_cmg_gran_colombian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. venezuelan is free for the gran_colombian merge.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. venezuelan passes its gates for the gran_colombian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_gran_colombian_venezuelan ?= 1
	te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_venezuelan }
}

# Country scope. venezuelan joined the gran_colombian merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_venezuelan ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_venezuelan
}

# Country scope. venezuelan (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the gran_colombian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_gran_colombian_venezuelan ?= 1
	te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_venezuelan ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_venezuelan }
	NOT = { te_cmg_gran_colombian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. ecuadorian is free for the gran_colombian merge.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. ecuadorian passes its gates for the gran_colombian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_gran_colombian_ecuadorian ?= 1
	te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ecuadorian }
}

# Country scope. ecuadorian joined the gran_colombian merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_ecuadorian ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ecuadorian
}

# Country scope. ecuadorian (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the gran_colombian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_gran_colombian_ecuadorian ?= 1
	te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_ecuadorian ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ecuadorian }
	NOT = { te_cmg_gran_colombian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the gran_colombian merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_gran_colombian_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_gran_colombian
			global_var:te_cm_starter_gran_colombian = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_gran_colombian_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_colombian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:colombian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_venezuelan }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:venezuelan value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ecuadorian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:ecuadorian value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The gran_colombian merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_gran_colombian }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_gran_colombian
			global_var:te_cm_starter_gran_colombian = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the gran_colombian merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_gran_colombian (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_gran_colombian
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_gran_colombian
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_gran_colombian
			te_cmg_gran_colombian_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The gran_colombian merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_gran_colombian.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_gran_colombian
	global_var:te_cm_starter_gran_colombian = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_gran_colombian }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_gran_colombian }
}

# Any scope. No part of the gran_colombian merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_colombian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_colombian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_venezuelan ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_venezuelan }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_ecuadorian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ecuadorian }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The gran_colombian merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_colombian ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_colombian
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_venezuelan ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_venezuelan
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_ecuadorian ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ecuadorian
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_colombian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_colombian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_venezuelan ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_venezuelan }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_ecuadorian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ecuadorian }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the gran_colombian merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_gran_colombian_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:colombian
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:venezuelan
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:ecuadorian
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_gran_colombian_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_measured = yes
			te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_gran_colombian_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_measured = yes
			te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_gran_colombian_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_measured = yes
			te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_gran_colombian ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- chinese (han, yue, min, hakka) ----

# Any scope. The chinese merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_chinese_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_han
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the chinese merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_chinese_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:han
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:yue
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:min
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:hakka
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_chinese_core_ok = {
	te_cmg_chinese_han_measured = yes
	OR = {
		te_cmg_chinese_yue_measured = yes
		te_cmg_chinese_yue_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_chinese_min_measured = yes
		te_cmg_chinese_min_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_chinese_hakka_measured = yes
		te_cmg_chinese_hakka_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. min (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the chinese merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_chinese_min_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_chinese_min ?= 1
	te_cmg_chinese_min_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_min ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_min }
	NOT = { te_cmg_chinese_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. hakka is free for the chinese merge.
te_cmg_chinese_hakka_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. hakka passes its gates for the chinese merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_chinese_hakka_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_chinese_hakka ?= 1
	te_cmg_chinese_hakka_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hakka }
}

# Country scope. hakka joined the chinese merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_chinese_hakka_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_hakka ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hakka
}

# Country scope. hakka (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the chinese merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_chinese_hakka_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_chinese_hakka ?= 1
	te_cmg_chinese_hakka_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_hakka ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hakka }
	NOT = { te_cmg_chinese_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the chinese merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_chinese_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_chinese_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_chinese
			global_var:te_cm_starter_chinese = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_chinese_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yue }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:yue value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_min }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:min value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hakka }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:hakka value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The chinese merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_chinese_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_chinese }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_chinese
			global_var:te_cm_starter_chinese = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the chinese merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_chinese (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_chinese_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_chinese
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_chinese
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_chinese
			te_cmg_chinese_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The chinese merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_chinese.
te_cmg_chinese_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_chinese
	global_var:te_cm_starter_chinese = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_chinese }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_chinese }
}

# Any scope. No part of the chinese merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_chinese_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_yue ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yue }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_min ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_min }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_hakka ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hakka }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The chinese merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_chinese_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_yue ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yue
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_min ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_min
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_hakka ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hakka
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_yue ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yue }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_min ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_min }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_chinese_hakka ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hakka }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the chinese merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_chinese_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_chinese_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:han
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:yue
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:min
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:hakka
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_chinese_core_1_tt
		te_cmg_chinese_han_measured = yes
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_chinese_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_chinese_yue_measured = yes
			te_cmg_chinese_yue_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_chinese_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_chinese_min_measured = yes
			te_cmg_chinese_min_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_chinese_core_4_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_chinese_hakka_measured = yes
			te_cmg_chinese_hakka_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_chinese ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- japanese (japanese, ryukyuan) ----

# Any scope. The japanese merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_japanese_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_japanese
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the japanese merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_japanese_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:japanese
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:ryukyuan
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_japanese ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_japanese_core_ok = {
	te_cmg_japanese_japanese_measured = yes
	OR = {
		te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_measured = yes
		te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. japanese is free for the japanese merge.
te_cmg_japanese_japanese_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. japanese passes its gates for the japanese merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_japanese_japanese_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_japanese_japanese ?= 1
	te_cmg_japanese_japanese_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_japanese }
}

# Country scope. japanese (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the japanese merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_japanese_japanese_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_japanese_japanese ?= 1
	te_cmg_japanese_japanese_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_japanese_japanese ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_japanese }
	NOT = { te_cmg_japanese_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. ryukyuan is free for the japanese merge.
te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. ryukyuan passes its gates for the japanese merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_japanese_ryukyuan ?= 1
	te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ryukyuan }
}

# Country scope. ryukyuan joined the japanese merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_japanese_ryukyuan ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ryukyuan
}

# Country scope. ryukyuan (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the japanese merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_japanese_ryukyuan ?= 1
	te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_japanese_ryukyuan ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ryukyuan }
	NOT = { te_cmg_japanese_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }

			te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_measured = yes

# ---- arab (maghrebi, misri, mashriqi, bedouin, yemenite) ----

# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.

	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_arab
}

# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a

# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).

	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:maghrebi
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:misri
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:mashriqi
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:bedouin
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:yemenite
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 2 }

		te_cmg_arab_misri_measured = yes
		te_cmg_arab_misri_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_arab_mashriqi_measured = yes
		te_cmg_arab_mashriqi_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_arab_bedouin_measured = yes
		te_cmg_arab_bedouin_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_arab_yemenite_measured = yes
		te_cmg_arab_yemenite_switched_in = yes
	}
}

	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_mashriqi }
}

# Country scope. mashriqi joined the arab merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_arab_mashriqi_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_mashriqi ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_mashriqi
}

# Country scope. mashriqi (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the arab merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_arab_mashriqi_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_arab_mashriqi ?= 1
	te_cmg_arab_mashriqi_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_mashriqi ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_mashriqi }
	NOT = { te_cmg_arab_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

	always = yes

# Country scope. sudanese (tier 1b) has spent the years together its tier asks for.

	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_arab_sudanese } var:te_cm_years_arab_sudanese >= te_cm_years_tier2 }
