	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bidan }
	NOT = { te_cmg_arab_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	te_cmg_arab_bidan_years_met = yes
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_arab_bidan ?= 1
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the arab merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_arab_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_arab_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_arab
			global_var:te_cm_starter_arab = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_arab_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_maghrebi }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:maghrebi value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_misri }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:misri value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_mashriqi }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:mashriqi value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bedouin }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:bedouin value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yemenite }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:yemenite value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sudanese }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:sudanese value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_haratin }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:haratin value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bidan }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:bidan value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The arab merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_arab_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_arab }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_arab
			global_var:te_cm_starter_arab = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the arab merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_arab (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_arab_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_arab
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_arab
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_arab
			te_cmg_arab_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The arab merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_arab.
te_cmg_arab_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_arab
	global_var:te_cm_starter_arab = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_arab }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_arab }
}

# Any scope. No part of the arab merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_arab_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_maghrebi ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_maghrebi }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_misri ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_misri }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_mashriqi ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_mashriqi }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_bedouin ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bedouin }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_yemenite ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yemenite }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_sudanese ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sudanese }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_haratin ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_haratin }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_bidan ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bidan }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The arab merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_arab_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_maghrebi ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_maghrebi
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_misri ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_misri
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_mashriqi ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_mashriqi
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_bedouin ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bedouin
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_yemenite ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yemenite
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_maghrebi ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_maghrebi }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_misri ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_misri }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_mashriqi ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_mashriqi }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_bedouin ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bedouin }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_yemenite ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yemenite }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the arab merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_arab_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_arab_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:maghrebi
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:misri
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:mashriqi
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:bedouin
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:yemenite
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_arab_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_arab_maghrebi_measured = yes
			te_cmg_arab_maghrebi_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_arab_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_arab_misri_measured = yes
			te_cmg_arab_misri_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_arab_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_arab_mashriqi_measured = yes
			te_cmg_arab_mashriqi_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_arab_core_4_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_arab_bedouin_measured = yes
			te_cmg_arab_bedouin_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_arab_core_5_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_arab_yemenite_measured = yes
			te_cmg_arab_yemenite_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_arab ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- persian (persian, luri) ----

# Any scope. The persian merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_persian_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_persian
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the persian merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_persian_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:persian
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:luri
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_persian_core_ok = {
	te_cmg_persian_persian_measured = yes
	OR = {
		te_cmg_persian_luri_measured = yes
		te_cmg_persian_luri_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. persian is free for the persian merge.
te_cmg_persian_persian_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. persian passes its gates for the persian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_persian_persian_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_persian_persian ?= 1
	te_cmg_persian_persian_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_persian }
}

# Country scope. persian (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the persian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_persian_persian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_persian_persian ?= 1
	te_cmg_persian_persian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_persian ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_persian }
	NOT = { te_cmg_persian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. luri is free for the persian merge.
te_cmg_persian_luri_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. luri passes its gates for the persian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_persian_luri_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_persian_luri ?= 1
	te_cmg_persian_luri_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_luri }
}

# Country scope. luri joined the persian merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_persian_luri_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_luri ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_luri
}

# Country scope. luri (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the persian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_persian_luri_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_persian_luri ?= 1
	te_cmg_persian_luri_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_luri ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_luri }
	NOT = { te_cmg_persian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. tajik is free for the persian merge.
te_cmg_persian_tajik_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. tajik passes its gates for the persian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_persian_tajik_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_persian_tajik ?= 1
	te_cmg_persian_tajik_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tajik }
}

# Country scope. tajik joined the persian merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_persian_tajik_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_tajik ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tajik
}

# Country scope. tajik (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the persian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_persian_tajik_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_persian_tajik ?= 1
	te_cmg_persian_tajik_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_tajik ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tajik }
	NOT = { te_cmg_persian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_persian_tajik ?= 1
}

# Any scope. hazara is free for the persian merge.
te_cmg_persian_hazara_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. hazara passes its gates for the persian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_persian_hazara_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_persian_hazara ?= 1
	te_cmg_persian_hazara_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hazara }
}

# Country scope. hazara (tier 1b) has spent the years together its tier asks for.
te_cmg_persian_hazara_years_met = {
	has_variable = te_cm_years_persian_hazara
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_persian_hazara } var:te_cm_years_persian_hazara >= te_cm_years_tier2 }
}

# Country scope. hazara joined the persian merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_persian_hazara_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_hazara ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hazara
}

# Country scope. hazara (tier 1b) passes its gates and can join the persian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_persian_hazara_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_persian_hazara ?= 1
	te_cmg_persian_hazara_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_hazara ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hazara }
	NOT = { te_cmg_persian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	te_cmg_persian_hazara_years_met = yes
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_persian_hazara ?= 1
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the persian merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_persian_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_persian_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_persian
			global_var:te_cm_starter_persian = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_persian_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_luri }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:luri value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tajik }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:tajik value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hazara }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:hazara value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The persian merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_persian_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_persian }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_persian
			global_var:te_cm_starter_persian = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the persian merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_persian (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_persian_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_persian
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_persian
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_persian
			te_cmg_persian_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The persian merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_persian.
te_cmg_persian_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_persian
	global_var:te_cm_starter_persian = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_persian }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_persian }
}

# Any scope. No part of the persian merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_persian_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_luri ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_luri }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_tajik ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tajik }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_hazara ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hazara }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The persian merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_persian_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_luri ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_luri
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_luri ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_luri }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the persian merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_persian_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_persian_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:persian
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:luri
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_persian_core_1_tt
		te_cmg_persian_persian_measured = yes
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_persian_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_persian_luri_measured = yes
			te_cmg_persian_luri_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_persian ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- oghuz_turkic (turkish, azerbaijani) ----

# Any scope. The oghuz_turkic merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_oghuz_turkic
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the oghuz_turkic merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:turkish
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:azerbaijani
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2 }
	NOT = { te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_result_switched = yes }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_core_ok = {
	OR = {
		te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_measured = yes
		te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_measured = yes
		te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. turkish is free for the oghuz_turkic merge.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. turkish passes its gates for the oghuz_turkic merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_oghuz_turkic_turkish ?= 1
	te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkish }
}

# Country scope. turkish joined the oghuz_turkic merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkish ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkish
}

# Country scope. turkish (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the oghuz_turkic merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_oghuz_turkic_turkish ?= 1
	te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkish ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkish }
	NOT = { te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_oghuz_turkic }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. azerbaijani is free for the oghuz_turkic merge.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. azerbaijani passes its gates for the oghuz_turkic merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).

	te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_azerbaijani }
}

te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_azerbaijani
}

# Country scope. azerbaijani (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the oghuz_turkic merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani ?= 1
	te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_azerbaijani }
	NOT = { te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_oghuz_turkic }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkmen }

	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_oghuz_turkic_turkmen } var:te_cm_years_oghuz_turkic_turkmen >= te_cm_years_tier2 }
}

	global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkmen ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkmen
}

# Country scope. turkmen (tier 1b) passes its gates and can join the oghuz_turkic merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.

	var:te_cm_ok_oghuz_turkic_turkmen ?= 1
	te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkmen_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkmen ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkmen }
	NOT = { te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_oghuz_turkic }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkmen_years_met = yes
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_oghuz_turkic_turkmen ?= 1
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the oghuz_turkic merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_oghuz_turkic
			global_var:te_cm_starter_oghuz_turkic = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkish }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:turkish value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_azerbaijani }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:azerbaijani value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkmen }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:turkmen value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The oghuz_turkic merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_oghuz_turkic }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_oghuz_turkic
			global_var:te_cm_starter_oghuz_turkic = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the oghuz_turkic merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_oghuz_turkic (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.

	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_oghuz_turkic
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_oghuz_turkic
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_oghuz_turkic
			te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The oghuz_turkic merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_oghuz_turkic.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_oghuz_turkic
	global_var:te_cm_starter_oghuz_turkic = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_oghuz_turkic }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_oghuz_turkic }
}

# Any scope. No part of the oghuz_turkic merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkish ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkish }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_azerbaijani }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkmen ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkmen }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The oghuz_turkic merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkish ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkish
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_azerbaijani
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkish ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkish }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_azerbaijani }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the oghuz_turkic merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_result_not_merged_on
		NOT = { te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_result_switched = yes }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:turkish
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:azerbaijani
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_measured = yes
			te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_measured = yes
			te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_oghuz_turkic ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- hindustani (hindustani, avadhi, bundeli, chhattisgarhi, bageli) ----

# Any scope. The hindustani merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_hindustani_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hindustani
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the hindustani merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_hindustani_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:hindustani
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:avadhi
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:bundeli
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:chhattisgarhi
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:bageli
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_hindustani_core_ok = {
	te_cmg_hindustani_hindustani_measured = yes
	OR = {
		te_cmg_hindustani_avadhi_measured = yes
		te_cmg_hindustani_avadhi_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_hindustani_bundeli_measured = yes
		te_cmg_hindustani_bundeli_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_hindustani_chhattisgarhi_measured = yes
		te_cmg_hindustani_chhattisgarhi_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_measured = yes
		te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. hindustani is free for the hindustani merge.
te_cmg_hindustani_hindustani_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. hindustani passes its gates for the hindustani merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_hindustani_hindustani_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_hindustani_hindustani ?= 1
	te_cmg_hindustani_hindustani_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hindustani }
}

# Country scope. hindustani (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the hindustani merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_hindustani_hindustani_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_hindustani_hindustani ?= 1
	te_cmg_hindustani_hindustani_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_hindustani ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hindustani }
	NOT = { te_cmg_hindustani_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. avadhi is free for the hindustani merge.
te_cmg_hindustani_avadhi_available = {
	always = yes

# Country scope. avadhi joined the hindustani merge and has switched into its result.

	global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_avadhi ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_avadhi
}

# Country scope. avadhi (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the hindustani merge now: it has not switched

	NOT = { te_cmg_hindustani_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the hindustani merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_hindustani_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_hindustani_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_hindustani
			global_var:te_cm_starter_hindustani = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_hindustani_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_avadhi }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:avadhi value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bundeli }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:bundeli value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chhattisgarhi }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:chhattisgarhi value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bageli }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:bageli value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The hindustani merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_hindustani_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_hindustani }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_hindustani
			global_var:te_cm_starter_hindustani = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the hindustani merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_hindustani (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_hindustani_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_hindustani
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_hindustani
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_hindustani
			te_cmg_hindustani_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The hindustani merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_hindustani.
te_cmg_hindustani_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_hindustani
	global_var:te_cm_starter_hindustani = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_hindustani }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_hindustani }
}

# Any scope. No part of the hindustani merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_hindustani_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_avadhi ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_avadhi }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bundeli ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bundeli }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_chhattisgarhi ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chhattisgarhi }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bageli ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bageli }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The hindustani merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_hindustani_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_avadhi ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_avadhi
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bundeli ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bundeli
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_chhattisgarhi ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chhattisgarhi
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bageli ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bageli
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_avadhi ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_avadhi }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bundeli ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bundeli }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_chhattisgarhi ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chhattisgarhi }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_hindustani_bageli ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bageli }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the hindustani merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_hindustani_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_hindustani_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:hindustani
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:avadhi
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:bundeli
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:chhattisgarhi
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:bageli
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_hindustani_core_1_tt
		te_cmg_hindustani_hindustani_measured = yes
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_hindustani_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_hindustani_avadhi_measured = yes
			te_cmg_hindustani_avadhi_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_hindustani_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_hindustani_bundeli_measured = yes
			te_cmg_hindustani_bundeli_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_hindustani_core_4_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_hindustani_chhattisgarhi_measured = yes
			te_cmg_hindustani_chhattisgarhi_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_hindustani_core_5_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_measured = yes
			te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_hindustani ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- dravidian (tamil, kannada, malayalam) ----

# Any scope. The dravidian merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_dravidian_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_dravidian
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the dravidian merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_dravidian_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:tamil
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:kannada
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:malayalam
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_dravidian ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_dravidian_core_ok = {
	OR = {
		te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_measured = yes
		te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_measured = yes
		te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_dravidian_malayalam_measured = yes
		te_cmg_dravidian_malayalam_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. tamil is free for the dravidian merge.
te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. tamil passes its gates for the dravidian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_dravidian_tamil ?= 1
	te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tamil }
}

# Country scope. tamil joined the dravidian merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_tamil ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tamil
}

# Country scope. tamil (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the dravidian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_dravidian_tamil ?= 1
	te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_tamil ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tamil }
	NOT = { te_cmg_dravidian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. telegu is free for the dravidian merge.

}

# Country scope. telegu passes its gates for the dravidian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_dravidian_telegu_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
	te_cmg_dravidian_telegu_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_telegu }
}

# Country scope. telegu (tier 2) has spent the years together its tier asks for.
te_cmg_dravidian_telegu_years_met = {
	has_variable = te_cm_years_dravidian_telegu
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_dravidian_telegu } var:te_cm_years_dravidian_telegu >= te_cm_years_tier3 }
}

# Country scope. telegu joined the dravidian merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_dravidian_telegu_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_telegu
}

# Country scope. telegu (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the dravidian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_dravidian_telegu_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
	te_cmg_dravidian_telegu_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_telegu ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_telegu }
	NOT = { te_cmg_dravidian_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	te_cmg_dravidian_telegu_years_met = yes
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the dravidian merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_dravidian_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_dravidian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_dravidian ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_dravidian_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_dravidian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_dravidian ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_dravidian
			global_var:te_cm_starter_dravidian = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_dravidian_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tamil }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:tamil value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kannada }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:kannada value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_malayalam }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:malayalam value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_telegu }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:telegu value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The dravidian merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_dravidian_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_dravidian }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_dravidian
			global_var:te_cm_starter_dravidian = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the dravidian merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_dravidian (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_dravidian_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_dravidian ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_dravidian ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_dravidian
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_dravidian
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_dravidian
			te_cmg_dravidian_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The dravidian merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_dravidian.
te_cmg_dravidian_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_dravidian ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_dravidian ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_dravidian
	global_var:te_cm_starter_dravidian = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_dravidian }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_dravidian }
}

# Any scope. No part of the dravidian merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_dravidian_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_tamil ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tamil }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_kannada ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kannada }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_malayalam ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_malayalam }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_telegu ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_telegu }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The dravidian merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_dravidian_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_tamil ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tamil
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_kannada ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kannada
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_malayalam ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_malayalam
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_tamil ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tamil }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_kannada ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kannada }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_dravidian_malayalam ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_malayalam }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the dravidian merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_dravidian_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_dravidian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_dravidian ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_dravidian_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:tamil
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:kannada
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:malayalam
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_dravidian_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_measured = yes
			te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_dravidian_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_measured = yes
			te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_dravidian_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_dravidian_malayalam_measured = yes
			te_cmg_dravidian_malayalam_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- indonesian (javan, malay, sumatran, bornean) ----

# Any scope. The indonesian merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_indonesian_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the indonesian merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_indonesian_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:javan
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:malay
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:sumatran
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:bornean
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_indonesian ?= 2 }
	NOT = { te_cmg_indonesian_result_switched = yes }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_indonesian_core_ok = {
	OR = {
		te_cmg_indonesian_javan_measured = yes
		te_cmg_indonesian_javan_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_indonesian_malay_measured = yes
		te_cmg_indonesian_malay_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_measured = yes
		te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_measured = yes
		te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. javan is free for the indonesian merge.
te_cmg_indonesian_javan_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. javan passes its gates for the indonesian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_indonesian_javan_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_indonesian_javan ?= 1
	te_cmg_indonesian_javan_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_javan }
}

# Country scope. javan joined the indonesian merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_indonesian_javan_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_indonesian_javan ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_javan
}

# Country scope. javan (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the indonesian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_indonesian_javan_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_indonesian_javan ?= 1
	te_cmg_indonesian_javan_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_indonesian_javan ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_javan }
	NOT = { te_cmg_indonesian_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_indonesian }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. malay is free for the indonesian merge.
te_cmg_indonesian_malay_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. malay passes its gates for the indonesian merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_indonesian_malay_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_indonesian_malay ?= 1
	te_cmg_indonesian_malay_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_malay }
}

# Country scope. malay joined the indonesian merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_indonesian_malay_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_indonesian_malay ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_malay
}

# Country scope. malay (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the indonesian merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest

	NOT = { te_cmg_indonesian_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_cm_indonesian }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

			global_var:te_cm_starter_indonesian = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_indonesian_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_javan }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:javan value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_malay }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:malay value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sumatran }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:sumatran value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bornean }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:bornean value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {

					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:balinese value > 0 } }
				}
			}

	}

		}

			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bornean }
		}

}

# Country scope. Can this country start the indonesian merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_indonesian_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_indonesian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_indonesian ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_result_not_merged_on
		NOT = { te_cmg_indonesian_result_switched = yes }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_indonesian_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:javan
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:malay
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:sumatran
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:bornean
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_indonesian_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_indonesian_javan_measured = yes
			te_cmg_indonesian_javan_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_indonesian_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_indonesian_malay_measured = yes
			te_cmg_indonesian_malay_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_indonesian_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_measured = yes
			te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_indonesian_core_4_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_measured = yes
			te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- filipino (filipino, visayan, tagalog, ilocano) ----

# Any scope. The filipino merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_filipino_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the filipino merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_filipino_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:filipino
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:visayan
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:tagalog
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:ilocano
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2 }
	NOT = { te_cmg_filipino_result_switched = yes }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_filipino_core_ok = {
	te_cmg_filipino_filipino_measured = yes
	OR = {
		te_cmg_filipino_visayan_measured = yes
		te_cmg_filipino_visayan_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_measured = yes
		te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_measured = yes
		te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. filipino is free for the filipino merge.
te_cmg_filipino_filipino_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_filipino ?= 31 }
}

# Country scope. filipino passes its gates for the filipino merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_filipino_filipino_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_filipino_filipino ?= 1
	te_cmg_filipino_filipino_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino }
}

# Country scope. filipino (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the filipino merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_filipino_filipino_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_filipino_filipino ?= 1
	te_cmg_filipino_filipino_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_filipino ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino }
	NOT = { te_cmg_filipino_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_filipino }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. visayan is free for the filipino merge.
te_cmg_filipino_visayan_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. visayan passes its gates for the filipino merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_filipino_visayan_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_filipino_visayan ?= 1
	te_cmg_filipino_visayan_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_visayan }
}

# Country scope. visayan joined the filipino merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_filipino_visayan_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_visayan ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_visayan
}

# Country scope. visayan (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the filipino merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_filipino_visayan_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_filipino_visayan ?= 1
	te_cmg_filipino_visayan_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_visayan ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_visayan }
	NOT = { te_cmg_filipino_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_filipino }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. tagalog is free for the filipino merge.
te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. tagalog passes its gates for the filipino merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_filipino_tagalog ?= 1
	te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tagalog }
}

# Country scope. tagalog joined the filipino merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_tagalog ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tagalog
}

# Country scope. tagalog (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the filipino merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_filipino_tagalog ?= 1
	te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_tagalog ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tagalog }
	NOT = { te_cmg_filipino_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_filipino }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. ilocano is free for the filipino merge.
te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. ilocano passes its gates for the filipino merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_filipino_ilocano ?= 1
	te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ilocano }
}

# Country scope. ilocano joined the filipino merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_ilocano ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ilocano
}

# Country scope. ilocano (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the filipino merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33) and no higher merge has joined that result (R38), and the rest
# of its gates hold.
te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_filipino_ilocano ?= 1
	te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_ilocano ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ilocano }
	NOT = { te_cmg_filipino_result_switched = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_in_filipino }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the filipino merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_filipino_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_filipino_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_filipino
			global_var:te_cm_starter_filipino = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_filipino_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_visayan }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:visayan value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tagalog }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:tagalog value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ilocano }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:ilocano value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The filipino merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_filipino_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_filipino }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_filipino
			global_var:te_cm_starter_filipino = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the filipino merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_filipino (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_filipino_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_filipino
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_filipino
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_filipino
			te_cmg_filipino_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The filipino merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_filipino.
te_cmg_filipino_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_filipino
	global_var:te_cm_starter_filipino = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_filipino }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_filipino }
}

# Any scope. No part of the filipino merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_filipino_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_visayan ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_visayan }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_tagalog ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tagalog }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_ilocano ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ilocano }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The filipino merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_filipino_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_visayan ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_visayan
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_tagalog ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tagalog
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_ilocano ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ilocano
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_visayan ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_visayan }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_tagalog ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tagalog }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_ilocano ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ilocano }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the filipino merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_filipino_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_result_not_merged_on
		NOT = { te_cmg_filipino_result_switched = yes }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_filipino_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:filipino
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:visayan
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:tagalog
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:ilocano
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_filipino_core_1_tt
		te_cmg_filipino_filipino_measured = yes
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_filipino_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_filipino_visayan_measured = yes
			te_cmg_filipino_visayan_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_filipino_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_measured = yes
			te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_filipino_core_4_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_measured = yes
			te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_filipino ?= 1
	}
}

	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_nguni
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the nguni merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a

# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).

	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:nguni
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:zulu
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:xhosa
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_nguni ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or

	OR = {
		te_cmg_nguni_zulu_measured = yes
		te_cmg_nguni_zulu_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		te_cmg_nguni_xhosa_measured = yes
		te_cmg_nguni_xhosa_switched_in = yes
	}
}

}
