# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the nguni merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_nguni_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_nguni ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_nguni ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_nguni_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_nguni ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_nguni ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_nguni
			global_var:te_cm_starter_nguni = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_nguni_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nguni }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:nguni value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_zulu }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:zulu value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_xhosa }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:xhosa value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The nguni merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_nguni_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_nguni }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_nguni
			global_var:te_cm_starter_nguni = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the nguni merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_nguni (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_nguni_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_nguni ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_nguni ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_nguni
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_nguni
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_nguni
			te_cmg_nguni_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The nguni merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_nguni.
te_cmg_nguni_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_nguni ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_nguni ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_nguni
	global_var:te_cm_starter_nguni = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_nguni }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_nguni }
}

# Any scope. No part of the nguni merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_nguni_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_nguni ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nguni }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_zulu ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_zulu }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_xhosa ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_xhosa }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The nguni merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_nguni_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_nguni ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nguni
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_zulu ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_zulu
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_xhosa ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_xhosa
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_nguni ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nguni }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_zulu ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_zulu }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_nguni_xhosa ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_xhosa }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the nguni merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_nguni_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_nguni ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_nguni ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_nguni_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:nguni
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:zulu
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:xhosa
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_1
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_nguni_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_nguni_nguni_measured = yes
			te_cmg_nguni_nguni_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_nguni_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_nguni_zulu_measured = yes
			te_cmg_nguni_zulu_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_nguni_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			te_cmg_nguni_xhosa_measured = yes
			te_cmg_nguni_xhosa_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_nguni ?= 1
	}
}

# ---- latin (french, cm_italian, spanish, portuguese) ----

# Any scope. The latin merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_latin_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_latin
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the latin merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_latin_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:french
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_italian
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:spanish
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:portuguese
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_latin_core_ok = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			te_cmg_latin_french_measured = yes
			te_cmg_latin_french_years_met = yes
		}
		te_cmg_latin_french_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			te_cmg_latin_cm_italian_measured = yes
			te_cmg_latin_cm_italian_years_met = yes
		}
		te_cmg_latin_cm_italian_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			te_cmg_latin_spanish_measured = yes
			te_cmg_latin_spanish_years_met = yes
		}
		te_cmg_latin_spanish_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			te_cmg_latin_portuguese_measured = yes
			te_cmg_latin_portuguese_years_met = yes
		}
		te_cmg_latin_portuguese_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. french is free for the latin merge.
te_cmg_latin_french_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_french ?= 10 }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 2
			te_cmg_french_all_switched = yes
		}
		NOR = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_french_wallonian ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_french_occitan ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_french_catalan ?= 1
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. french passes its gates for the latin merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_latin_french_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_latin_french ?= 1
	te_cmg_latin_french_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french }
}

# Country scope. french (tier 2) has spent the years together its tier asks for.
te_cmg_latin_french_years_met = {
	has_variable = te_cm_years_latin_french
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_latin_french } var:te_cm_years_latin_french >= te_cm_years_tier3 }
}

# Country scope. french joined the latin merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_latin_french_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_french ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french
}

# Country scope. french (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the latin merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_latin_french_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_latin_french ?= 1
	te_cmg_latin_french_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_french ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french }
	NOT = { te_cmg_latin_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	te_cmg_latin_french_years_met = yes
}

# Any scope. cm_italian is free for the latin merge.
te_cmg_latin_cm_italian_available = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 2
			te_cmg_italian_all_switched = yes
		}
		NOR = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_italian_north_italian ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_italian_south_italian ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_italian_corsican ?= 1
		}
	}
}

# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_latin_argentine_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_latin_argentine ?= 1
	te_cmg_latin_argentine_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_argentine ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine }
	NOT = { te_cmg_latin_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	te_cmg_latin_argentine_years_met = yes
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_latin_argentine ?= 1
}

# Any scope. uruguayan is free for the latin merge.
te_cmg_latin_uruguayan_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_uruguayan ?= 15 }
}

# Country scope. uruguayan passes its gates for the latin merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_latin_uruguayan_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_latin_uruguayan ?= 1
	te_cmg_latin_uruguayan_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan }
}

# Country scope. uruguayan (tier 1b) has spent the years together its tier asks for.
te_cmg_latin_uruguayan_years_met = {
	has_variable = te_cm_years_latin_uruguayan
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_latin_uruguayan } var:te_cm_years_latin_uruguayan >= te_cm_years_tier2 }
}

# Country scope. uruguayan joined the latin merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_latin_uruguayan_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_uruguayan ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan
}

# Country scope. uruguayan (tier 1b) passes its gates and can join the latin merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_latin_uruguayan_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_latin_uruguayan ?= 1
	te_cmg_latin_uruguayan_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_uruguayan ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan }
	NOT = { te_cmg_latin_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	te_cmg_latin_uruguayan_years_met = yes
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_latin_uruguayan ?= 1
}

# Any scope. chilean is free for the latin merge.
te_cmg_latin_chilean_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. chilean passes its gates for the latin merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_latin_chilean_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_latin_chilean ?= 1
	te_cmg_latin_chilean_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chilean }
}

# Country scope. chilean (tier 1b) has spent the years together its tier asks for.
te_cmg_latin_chilean_years_met = {
	has_variable = te_cm_years_latin_chilean
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_latin_chilean } var:te_cm_years_latin_chilean >= te_cm_years_tier2 }
}

# Country scope. chilean joined the latin merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_latin_chilean_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_chilean ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chilean
}

# Country scope. chilean (tier 1b) passes its gates and can join the latin merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_latin_chilean_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_latin_chilean ?= 1
	te_cmg_latin_chilean_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_chilean ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chilean }
	NOT = { te_cmg_latin_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	te_cmg_latin_chilean_years_met = yes
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_latin_chilean ?= 1
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the latin merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_latin_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_latin_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_latin
			global_var:te_cm_starter_latin = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_latin_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:french value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_italian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:cm_italian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_spanish }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:spanish value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_portuguese }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:portuguese value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_romanian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:romanian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:platinean value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_platine }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:cm_platine value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:argentine value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:uruguayan value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chilean }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:chilean value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The latin merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_latin_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_latin }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_latin
			global_var:te_cm_starter_latin = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the latin merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_latin (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_latin_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_latin
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_latin
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_latin
			te_cmg_latin_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The latin merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_latin.
te_cmg_latin_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_latin
	global_var:te_cm_starter_latin = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_latin }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_latin }
}

# Any scope. No part of the latin merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_latin_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_french ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_cm_italian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_italian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_spanish ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_spanish }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_portuguese ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_portuguese }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_romanian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_romanian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_platinean ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_cm_platine ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_platine }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_argentine ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_uruguayan ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_chilean ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chilean }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The latin merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_latin_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_french ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_cm_italian ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_italian
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_spanish ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_spanish
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_portuguese ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_portuguese
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_french ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_cm_italian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_italian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_spanish ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_spanish }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_latin_portuguese ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_portuguese }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the latin merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_latin_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_latin_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:french
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_italian
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:spanish
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:portuguese
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_3
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_latin_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_latin_french_measured = yes
				te_cmg_latin_french_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_latin_french_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_latin_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_latin_cm_italian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_latin_cm_italian_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_latin_cm_italian_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_latin_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_latin_spanish_measured = yes
				te_cmg_latin_spanish_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_latin_spanish_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_latin_core_4_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_latin_portuguese_measured = yes
				te_cmg_latin_portuguese_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_latin_portuguese_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_latin ?= 1
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_latin_comp_french_tt
		global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 2
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_latin_comp_italian_tt
		global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 2
	}
}

# ---- pan_slavic (cm_east_slavic, cm_czechoslovak, cm_yugoslav) ----

# Any scope. The pan_slavic merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_pan_slavic
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the pan_slavic merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_pan_slavic_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_east_slavic
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_czechoslovak
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_yugoslav
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_core_ok = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_measured = yes
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_years_met = yes
		}
		te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_measured = yes
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_years_met = yes
		}
		te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_measured = yes
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_years_met = yes
		}
		te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. cm_east_slavic is free for the pan_slavic merge.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_available = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 2
			te_cmg_east_slavic_all_switched = yes
		}
		NOR = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_russian ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_ukrainian ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_byelorussian ?= 1
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. cm_east_slavic passes its gates for the pan_slavic merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_east_slavic }
}

# Country scope. cm_east_slavic (tier 2) has spent the years together its tier asks for.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_years_met = {
	has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic } var:te_cm_years_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic >= te_cm_years_tier3 }
}

# Country scope. cm_east_slavic joined the pan_slavic merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_east_slavic
}

# Country scope. cm_east_slavic (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the pan_slavic merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_east_slavic }
	NOT = { te_cmg_pan_slavic_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_years_met = yes
}

# Any scope. cm_czechoslovak is free for the pan_slavic merge.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_available = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 2
			te_cmg_czechoslovak_all_switched = yes
		}
		NOR = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_czech ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_slovak ?= 1

		}
	}
}

}

# Country scope. cm_czechoslovak (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the pan_slavic merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak ?= 1 }

# Any scope. cm_yugoslav is free for the pan_slavic merge.

		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 2
			te_cmg_yugoslav_all_switched = yes
		}
		NOR = {

			global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_croat ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_bosniak ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_slovene ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_yugoslav_bulgarian ?= 1
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. cm_yugoslav passes its gates for the pan_slavic merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).

	te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_yugoslav }
}

# Country scope. cm_yugoslav (tier 2) has spent the years together its tier asks for.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_years_met = {
	has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav } var:te_cm_years_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav >= te_cm_years_tier3 }
}

# Country scope. cm_yugoslav joined the pan_slavic merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_yugoslav
}

# Country scope. cm_yugoslav (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the pan_slavic merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_yugoslav }
	NOT = { te_cmg_pan_slavic_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_years_met = yes
}

# Any scope. polish is free for the pan_slavic merge.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_polish_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. polish passes its gates for the pan_slavic merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_pan_slavic_polish_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_slavic_polish_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_polish }

	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian
}

# Country scope. bulgarian (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the pan_slavic merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.

	te_cmg_pan_slavic_bulgarian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_bulgarian ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian }
	NOT = { te_cmg_pan_slavic_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	te_cmg_pan_slavic_bulgarian_years_met = yes
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic_bulgarian ?= 1
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the pan_slavic merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_pan_slavic_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_slavic
			global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_slavic = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_pan_slavic_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_east_slavic }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:cm_east_slavic value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_czechoslovak }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:cm_czechoslovak value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_yugoslav }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:cm_yugoslav value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_polish }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:polish value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovene }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:slovene value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:bulgarian value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The pan_slavic merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_slavic }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_slavic
			global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_slavic = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the pan_slavic merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_pan_slavic (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_slavic
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_slavic
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_pan_slavic
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The pan_slavic merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_pan_slavic.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_slavic
	global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_slavic = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_slavic }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_pan_slavic }
}

# Any scope. No part of the pan_slavic merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_east_slavic }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_czechoslovak }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_yugoslav }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_polish }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_slovene ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovene }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_bulgarian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The pan_slavic merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_east_slavic
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_czechoslovak
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_yugoslav
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_east_slavic }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_czechoslovak }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_yugoslav }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the pan_slavic merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_slavic_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_east_slavic
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_czechoslovak
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_yugoslav
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_3
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_slavic_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_slavic_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_slavic_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic ?= 1
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_slavic_comp_east_slavic_tt
		global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 2
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_slavic_comp_czechoslovak_tt
		global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 2
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_slavic_comp_yugoslav_tt
		global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 2
	}
}

# ---- pan_turkic (cm_oghuz_turkic, uzbek, kazak, tatar, kirgiz) ----

# Any scope. The pan_turkic merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_pan_turkic
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the pan_turkic merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_pan_turkic_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_oghuz_turkic
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:uzbek
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:kazak
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:tatar
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:kirgiz
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_core_ok = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_measured = yes
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_years_met = yes
		}
		te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_measured = yes
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_years_met = yes
		}
		te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_kazak_measured = yes
			te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
		}
		te_cmg_pan_turkic_kazak_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_tatar_measured = yes
			te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_tatar_years_met = yes
		}
		te_cmg_pan_turkic_tatar_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_kirgiz_measured = yes
			te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
		}
		te_cmg_pan_turkic_kirgiz_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. cm_oghuz_turkic is free for the pan_turkic merge.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_available = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2
			te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_all_switched = yes
		}
		NOR = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkish ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkmen ?= 1
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. cm_oghuz_turkic passes its gates for the pan_turkic merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_oghuz_turkic }
}

# Country scope. cm_oghuz_turkic (tier 2) has spent the years together its tier asks for.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_years_met = {
	has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic } var:te_cm_years_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic >= te_cm_years_tier3 }
}

# Country scope. cm_oghuz_turkic joined the pan_turkic merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_oghuz_turkic
}

# Country scope. cm_oghuz_turkic (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the pan_turkic merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_oghuz_turkic }
	NOT = { te_cmg_pan_turkic_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_years_met = yes
}

# Any scope. uzbek is free for the pan_turkic merge.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. uzbek passes its gates for the pan_turkic merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_turkic_uzbek ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uzbek }
}

# Country scope. uzbek (tier 2) has spent the years together its tier asks for.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_years_met = {
	has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_turkic_uzbek
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_turkic_uzbek } var:te_cm_years_pan_turkic_uzbek >= te_cm_years_tier3 }
}

# Country scope. uzbek joined the pan_turkic merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_uzbek ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uzbek
}

# Country scope. uzbek (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the pan_turkic merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_turkic_uzbek ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_uzbek ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uzbek }
	NOT = { te_cmg_pan_turkic_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_years_met = yes
}

	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	te_cmg_pan_turkic_uighur_years_met = yes
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic_uighur ?= 1
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the pan_turkic merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_pan_turkic_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_turkic
			global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_turkic = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_pan_turkic_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_oghuz_turkic }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:cm_oghuz_turkic value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uzbek }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:uzbek value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kazak }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:kazak value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tatar }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:tatar value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kirgiz }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:kirgiz value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bashkir }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:bashkir value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_crimean_tatar }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:crimean_tatar value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_caucasian_turk }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:caucasian_turk value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uighur }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:uighur value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The pan_turkic merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_turkic }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_turkic
			global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_turkic = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the pan_turkic merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_pan_turkic (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_turkic
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_turkic
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_pan_turkic
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The pan_turkic merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_pan_turkic.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_turkic
	global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_turkic = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_turkic }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_pan_turkic }
}

# Any scope. No part of the pan_turkic merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_oghuz_turkic }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_uzbek ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uzbek }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_kazak ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kazak }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_tatar ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tatar }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_kirgiz ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kirgiz }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_bashkir ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bashkir }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_crimean_tatar }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_caucasian_turk ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_caucasian_turk }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_uighur ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uighur }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The pan_turkic merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_oghuz_turkic
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_uzbek ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uzbek
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_kazak ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kazak
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_tatar ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tatar
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_kirgiz ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kirgiz
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_oghuz_turkic }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_uzbek ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uzbek }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_kazak ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kazak }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_tatar ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tatar }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_kirgiz ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kirgiz }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the pan_turkic merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_turkic_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_oghuz_turkic
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:uzbek
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:kazak
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:tatar
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:kirgiz
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_3
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_turkic_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_turkic_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_turkic_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_kazak_measured = yes
				te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
			}
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_kazak_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_turkic_core_4_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_tatar_measured = yes
				te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_tatar_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_tatar_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_turkic_core_5_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_kirgiz_measured = yes
				te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
			}
			te_cmg_pan_turkic_kirgiz_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic ?= 1
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_turkic_comp_oghuz_turkic_tt
		global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2
	}
}

# ---- pan_malay (cm_indonesian, filipino) ----

# Any scope. The pan_malay merge's result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): the merge then joins, converts,
# measures and switches nothing more, and is no candidate. Never true for a result no other merge lists.
te_cmg_pan_malay_result_switched = {
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_pan_malay
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the pan_malay merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, the merge is not complete and, where its result is a
# part of another merge, that result has not switched into it (R33: then the merge does nothing more). Where
# another merge can take a core part, that part has not switched there (te_cmg_<m>_core_left, R38).
te_cmg_pan_malay_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_indonesian
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:filipino
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_malay ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot is met: an alternative that passes its gates now (and, in tier 1b or
# tier 2, has its years together), or one that joined this merge and has switched.
te_cmg_pan_malay_core_ok = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_measured = yes
			te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_years_met = yes
		}
		te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_switched_in = yes
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_measured = yes
			te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_years_met = yes
		}
		te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_switched_in = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. cm_indonesian is free for the pan_malay merge.
te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_available = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_indonesian ?= 2
			te_cmg_indonesian_all_switched = yes
		}
		NOR = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_indonesian_javan ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_indonesian_malay ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_indonesian_sumatran ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_indonesian_bornean ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_indonesian_balinese ?= 1
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. cm_indonesian passes its gates for the pan_malay merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_malay_cm_indonesian ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian }
}

# Country scope. cm_indonesian (tier 2) has spent the years together its tier asks for.
te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_years_met = {
	has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_malay_cm_indonesian
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_malay_cm_indonesian } var:te_cm_years_pan_malay_cm_indonesian >= te_cm_years_tier3 }
}

# Country scope. cm_indonesian joined the pan_malay merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_cm_indonesian ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian
}

# Country scope. cm_indonesian (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the pan_malay merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_malay_cm_indonesian ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_cm_indonesian ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian }
	NOT = { te_cmg_pan_malay_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_years_met = yes
}

# Any scope. filipino is free for the pan_malay merge.
te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_filipino ?= 26 }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2
			te_cmg_filipino_all_switched = yes
		}
		NOR = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_visayan ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_tagalog ?= 1
			global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_ilocano ?= 1
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. filipino passes its gates for the pan_malay merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_malay_filipino ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino }
}

# Country scope. filipino (tier 2) has spent the years together its tier asks for.
te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_years_met = {
	has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_malay_filipino
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_malay_filipino } var:te_cm_years_pan_malay_filipino >= te_cm_years_tier3 }
}

# Country scope. filipino joined the pan_malay merge and has switched into its result.
te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_switched_in = {
	global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_filipino ?= 1
	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino
}

# Country scope. filipino (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the pan_malay merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_malay_filipino ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_filipino ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino }
	NOT = { te_cmg_pan_malay_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_years_met = yes
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the pan_malay merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_pan_malay_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_malay ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_pan_malay ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_pan_malay_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_pan_malay ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_pan_malay ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_malay
			global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_malay = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_pan_malay_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:cm_indonesian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:filipino value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The pan_malay merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_pan_malay_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_malay }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_malay
			global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_malay = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the pan_malay merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_pan_malay (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_pan_malay_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_pan_malay ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_pan_malay ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_malay
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_malay
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_pan_malay
			te_cmg_pan_malay_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The pan_malay merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_pan_malay.
te_cmg_pan_malay_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_pan_malay ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_pan_malay ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_malay
	global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_malay = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_malay }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_pan_malay }
}

# Any scope. No part of the pan_malay merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_pan_malay_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_cm_indonesian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_filipino ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The pan_malay merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_pan_malay_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_cm_indonesian ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_filipino ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_cm_indonesian ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_malay_filipino ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the pan_malay merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_pan_malay_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_malay ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_pan_malay ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_malay_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_indonesian
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:filipino
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_3
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_malay_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_malay_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_malay ?= 1
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_malay_comp_indonesian_tt
		global_var:te_cm_state_indonesian ?= 2
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_pan_malay_comp_filipino_tt
		global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2
	}
}

	has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yao
}

# Country scope. yao (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the east_african merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_east_african_yao_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_east_african_yao ?= 1
	te_cmg_east_african_yao_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_yao ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yao }
	NOT = { te_cmg_east_african_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	te_cmg_east_african_yao_years_met = yes
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_east_african_yao ?= 1
}

# Any scope. makua is free for the east_african merge.
te_cmg_east_african_makua_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. makua passes its gates for the east_african merge now: held and accepted, free for it,
# and not yet switched (a switched part has no pops left to measure).
te_cmg_east_african_makua_measured = {
	var:te_cm_ok_east_african_makua ?= 1
	te_cmg_east_african_makua_available = yes
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_makua }
}

# Country scope. makua (tier 2) has spent the years together its tier asks for.
te_cmg_east_african_makua_years_met = {
	has_variable = te_cm_years_east_african_makua
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_east_african_makua } var:te_cm_years_east_african_makua >= te_cm_years_tier3 }

# Country scope. kikuyu (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the east_african merge now: it has not switched
# (R32), the merge's own result has not (R33), and the rest of its gates hold.
te_cmg_east_african_kikuyu_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_east_african_kikuyu ?= 1
	te_cmg_east_african_kikuyu_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_kikuyu ?= 1 }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kikuyu }
	NOT = { te_cmg_east_african_result_switched = yes }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	te_cmg_east_african_kikuyu_years_met = yes
	var:te_cm_sol_ok_east_african_kikuyu ?= 1
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the east_african merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count. Not once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33): nothing more is joined or measured.
te_cmg_east_african_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_east_african_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african
			global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african = { is_country_alive = yes }
			NOT = { te_cmg_east_african_result_switched = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swahili }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:swahili value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nyamwezi }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:nyamwezi value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sukuma }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:sukuma value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yao }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:yao value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_makua }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:makua value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_lacustrine_bantu }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:lacustrine_bantu value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kikuyu }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:kikuyu value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The east_african merge's starter is missing, or is no longer a living country.
te_cmg_east_african_starter_gone = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african }
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african
			global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african = { is_country_alive = no }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. This country started the east_african merge, which is running or complete: it is the global starter,
# or it carries te_cm_started_east_african (set by te_cm_start_merge, inherited by a civil war's winner, which
# continues the nation) while the global starter is missing or dead.
te_cmg_east_african_is_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 2
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african
			this = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = te_cm_started_east_african
			te_cmg_east_african_starter_gone = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The east_african merge is running or complete under another living country: this one is not its
# global starter and carries no te_cm_started_east_african.
te_cmg_east_african_has_other_starter = {
	OR = {
		global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 1
		global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 2
	}
	exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african
	global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african = { is_country_alive = yes }
	NOT = { this = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african }
	NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_started_east_african }
}

# Any scope. No part of the east_african merge that joined is still unswitched: a part that joins late, after the
# core has switched and the merge is complete, keeps the merge from concluding until it has switched too.
te_cmg_east_african_all_switched = {
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_swahili ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swahili }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_nyamwezi ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nyamwezi }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_sukuma ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sukuma }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_yao ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yao }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_makua ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_makua }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_lacustrine_bantu ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_lacustrine_bantu }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_kikuyu ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kikuyu }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The east_african merge's core is switched: no core part that joined is left unswitched, and at least one
# has switched. The second clause keeps an optional part that switches first from completing a merge whose core
# has not begun. te_cm_switch_part sets the merge's state to 2 on this.
te_cmg_east_african_core_switched = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_swahili ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swahili
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_nyamwezi ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nyamwezi
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_sukuma ?= 1
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sukuma
		}
	}
	NOR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_swahili ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swahili }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_nyamwezi ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nyamwezi }
		}
		AND = {
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_sukuma ?= 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sukuma }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the east_african merge now? The merge is idle, a core culture is
# primary, the technology is known, every core slot is met, the standard-of-living gap is closed, the
# component merges are complete and no vanilla entry on a core part is still open in any country (or the wait ran its course).
# Each condition sits in its own custom_tooltip, which the button and the entry show as a reason.
te_cmg_east_african_can_start = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_idle
		NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 2 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_east_african_primary_tt
		OR = {
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:swahili
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:nyamwezi
			country_has_primary_culture = cu:sukuma
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_tech_3
		te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_east_african_core_1_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_east_african_swahili_measured = yes
				te_cmg_east_african_swahili_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_east_african_swahili_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_east_african_core_2_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_east_african_nyamwezi_measured = yes
				te_cmg_east_african_nyamwezi_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_east_african_nyamwezi_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cmg_east_african_core_3_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				te_cmg_east_african_sukuma_measured = yes
				te_cmg_east_african_sukuma_years_met = yes
			}
			te_cmg_east_african_sukuma_switched_in = yes
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = te_cm_tt_sol
		var:te_cm_sol_ok_east_african ?= 1
	}
}

# Culture scope; ROOT = the state, as in te_homeland_removal_candidate. Dynamic Homeland Progress leaves this
# culture's homeland in ROOT alone: it is a part that has switched, and the culture it switched into is
# a homeland of the state too (owner, 2026-11-07). The part's homeland follows its successor's: once that is removed
# (te_cmg_remove_switched_part_homelands) the part's goes with it. Not behind the rule: it is about map state.
# has_global_variable comes first in every clause, so a game with nothing switched prunes all 118 at once.
te_cmg_switched_part_kept = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german
			this = cu:north_german
			ROOT.state_region = { is_homeland = global_var:te_cm_switched_north_german }
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german
			this = cu:south_german
